tieu_de: Divine Majesty of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Son Thien Thich Hue Khanh
noi_dung:
The Divine Power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Son Thien Thich Hue Khanh

I read Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Vow Sutra and greatly praised all of the Bodhisattva's merits in saving sentient beings. Thinking back to the year I went to Cuu Hoa Mountain, the hardships along the way thanks to Bodhisattva's compassionate blessings, now I respectfully narrate as follows:

In the 32nd year of the Republic (1943), on the 1st day of the 10th lunar month, I took the morning bus to Nanjing. At that time, our country's white planes bombed Ha Quan, the whole scene was under curfew, and the bus to Vo Ho was stopped. When we arrived at Vo Ho at midnight, all the torches were off, there was no starlight, and the sky was pitch black. The Japanese army controlled the station very strictly. The train station is about a kilometer from the city. All the passengers were looking for a way to get into the city, but I was alone, without friends, arriving in a strange land at pitch-dark night, not knowing which direction to go. I'm still wondering. Suddenly a monk came and took me to an inn. I asked for the address and the monk chanted a bow and left. After I thought about it, it was obvious that the Bodhisattva appeared to give instructions.

The next morning, I took a boat to Dai Thong then went to Dong Pho and took a boat to Thanh Duong district by water, about 60 kilometers. The ferryman said: "This boat will definitely pass through Ky Son Lake." There was a group of people on there. If they saw anyone from the Japanese-occupied area passing by, they would often shoot down. In recent years, many people have died. Everyone was very scared. Personally, I don't care much. Because I came to Cuu Hoa Mountain to pay Buddha's pilgrimage, I disregarded life and death. Even if I was in danger, Bodhisattva would protect me. So I'm very calm. The sun had set, night was falling, the snow was blowing very coldly, at ten o'clock the boat started to anchor, I comforted the four passengers traveling with me, advising them not to be afraid. As for me, I sincerely chanted the Buddha's name and called the Bodhisattva Holy name, then sat cross-legged, clasped my hands and chanted respectfully and supplicated. After four hours it stopped. The passengers were silent and no one spoke. Just hear the sound of gurgling water, boats sailing downstream, on both sides of the banks are lush trees and magnificent mountains. The sounds of wild animals screaming were very pitiful. The moon was dim and covered with snow, everyone was scared. Luckily nothing unexpected happened.That is also thanks to the divine power of Bodhisattva's blessing. That's the second thing, when it was dawn, when I arrived in Thanh Duong district, I saw the citadel in ruins, the houses were dilapidated, the remaining intact houses were very rare. It was also because of the bombing by the Japanese Air Force in the summer of 1942 that this situation happened. From Thanh Duong district to Cuu Hoa mountain, up to 120 li (30 kilometers), snow covered the road. The traveler faltered, the next 60 miles of road were all forest roads, the road became even more difficult. If you want to find a guide, you can't find one. Suddenly there was a monk who wanted to go to Thuy Phong Pagoda and wanted to go with him. Having such a rare lucky opportunity, everyone was happy, because they met this special fate, and they all believed that Bodhisattva secretly blessed them. That's the third thing, that night stay at Thuy Phong. The next morning, depart for Cuu Hoa Son. From there it is about 80 li to Cuu Hoa Son. The road is winding and winding, climbing passes and wading streams is very difficult. In addition to the frozen snow, the road is slippery and difficult to find the way. Every step is a difficulty. Abbot Thuy Phong Tu felt embarrassed and deliberately held back, saying that in the past 18 years, this year was so cold. But I am determined to go on pilgrimage, why am I afraid of difficulties?Then we discussed and decided to leave tomorrow. The snow was several feet thick, making it difficult to distinguish the path, and the wind was bone-chillingly cold. Beyond some mountains, the path is narrow and dangerous, and the snow and ice are even more slippery. We took a step and fell once, our whole body was cold to the bone. If you have the will to worship the Bodhisattva, you should wholeheartedly recite the Buddha's name without worrying about difficulties. Surely all suffering and hardships will be relieved. Together we tried to climb a mountain, looking around at white snow and endless mountains. At that time, everyone had been walking for half a day, their limbs were cold, the wind blowing on their faces was as cold as a knife, they could no longer move forward, there was no one around, where could they find a place to rest? After walking a few more steps, we suddenly discovered there was a thatched house on the side of the mountain where we could take shelter from the cold. We built a fire to warm ourselves, and once we were cozy, we continued on our way. In the late afternoon, the weather turned cold, the wind blew stronger and the forest road became more slippery. As it got darker, the cold wind made me shiver, my teeth trembled. The road has many high, low and winding sections, making it even more difficult. We had no choice but to try to walk, fall, then get up again, through the forests and mountains.In the distance, one can glimpse the top of the hidden tower. Knowing that the Bodhisattva Holy Land was near, I was so happy that I forgot my fatigue. Walking feels light. Finally reached the mountain. Without the divine power of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, the deep forest would be covered with snow, freezing and the human body would not be able to get up. It would be buried in the snowy mountains. That's the fourth thing. When I reached the foot of the mountain at Quang Te Pagoda, not far from the Stupa, that night I went into the Tower to worship and admire the Bodhisattva's physical body. I stayed at that tower for one night, praising and praising the Bodhisattva's profound and profound merits, which made me prostrate even more to the ground and respectfully bow a hundred times. Recorded in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the World-Honored One praised the Bodhisattva that in the world of the ten directions, no one could imagine the divine might of the Bodhisattva, rescuing all the sins and sufferings of sentient beings. The Master spoke in such a way that it moved people to tears. I worship without feeling tired.

The next morning, we visited the Temples and famous Holy Land mountains, all with the guidance of Venerable Monks, we lit lamps and made all kinds of offerings. Everyone who heard this news praised it greatly. Unfortunately, in the past few years, due to war chaos, pilgrims were few and far between, Pagodas were in ruins, and a few large pagodas such as Dong Nhai and Long Hoa were all burned down by the Japanese army. Carrying the crime of destroying pagodas and stupas, not knowing how to repent, being ruined and losing the country is not enough to atone for past sins. Just consider it as the merit of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's ashram.

On Cuu Hoa Son mountain, there are ninety-nine solemn, towering peaks that are difficult to climb. Bodhisattva vows to spread deeply and have great affinity with sentient beings, so in times of peace, pilgrims come in droves. Following each other up the mountain, the road is like flat land. Tue Khanh came on this pilgrimage. With a sincere thought, I chanted the Holy name of Bodhisattva. Although I encountered many difficulties on the way, I was able to escape them all. Now that I remember, I would like to clearly state that this book is published to praise the Bodhisattva's virtues.

tieu_de: Sub: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Premonitions Near Literature
noi_dung:
Secondary:

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Inspiration

Close Literature

Ta Quan Phuc Hoa, the grandson of his second brother, and also the fourth-generation grandson of Ta Van Nhuong, is very loyal to Buddhism, and is also very interested in scientific research. It is said that Ta Quan's mother usually respects and believes in Buddhism, and especially recites the Ksitigarbha Sutra, and often prepares medicines to give to patients. At the age of 24, she fell into a coma, so she asked her servants to prepare vegetarian meals, brought monks in, and respectfully recited the Ksitigarbha Sutra for 3 days. Mother Ta Quan saw Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva appearing as a High Monk, wearing a robe, holding a Tich Truong, and said: "Your lifespan has ended. But thinking of the ancients, who now have great devotion to the Buddha, have done many good deeds, so now let them live for another twelve years." From then on the disease cured. After living until the age of 36, he peacefully passed away. Phuc Hoa said that in the past, he often heard his mother teach him to do many good deeds.

● Recorded by Radio Photographer.

Cao Tong Thanh Nu Si, whose name is Tuyet Tai, from Ngo Thuc district, whose mother is Mrs. Phan Thi, has been suffering from swelling all over her body for over three years, starting in the spring of Mau Thin year. The story is told: "According to doctors, this disease is called chronic vaginal discharge", you have to wait until the water in the skin runs out before you die, there is no way to cure it. At that time, I was still working in Than Giang and only came home once a month. In April, when I returned home, my mother's condition was at the point of danger, her skin was shiny like a mirror, her skin was full of swelling, her skin felt like it was about to crack, she was in excruciating pain, her crying was endless. I'm so sad and heartbroken. I had to ask for help from my friends who believed in Buddha. They instructed me to respectfully pray to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to save Mother's illness.

I immediately vowed to sincerely recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva thirty times every day and fast for three months. If my mother is cured, I will worship Buddha all my life, practice Ksitigarbha vows, save all sentient beings until the next life, and help sentient beings suffering in hell. On the morning of May 27, when the chanting was completed, in the afternoon my mother urinated continuously for a day and a half before stopping. The whole family was horrified and scared. My mother also thought she would no longer be able to recover. The doctors who came to examine him were very surprised, thinking that an elderly person who was over 73 years old and still in such good health could be able to clear his anus and have all the water flow out. Two or three days later, the skin's complexion returned to normal, the disease was completely cured, the skin was rosy, like the day a dry tree changed skin and healthy as usual. The old illness has completely healed.

Cao Tong Thanh Nu Si also added: "Since the day I relied on Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's inspiration to cure my Mother, my love and faith in Buddha has become even more sincere." On January 4, the year of the Snake, I went to Than district to pay my respects to Dharma Master Dai Ngu, but was rejected, saying that I had a relationship with the Great Master, and swore to practice the Ksitigarbha vow. The next day, the shaman transmitted Dafa to me. I sincerely practiced the Dharma. I swore to Buddha morning and evening, vowing to forever save sentient beings suffering in hell in my next life. That's why I have sympathy with the sentient beings of hell. On the night of the 20th of the month, I dreamed and felt confused, walking alone on the road towards the iron bridge as if there was a voice echoing in my ear, telling me to go up the bridge. Just after walking a few steps, I heard a pitiful cry and lament under the bridge, like the cries of thousands of people, young and old. At that time, I felt very sorry and sad. Remember when you were a child, you often heard people say that when building a bridge, many lives were needed to sacrifice, and there were no cries of the victims. I felt uneasy inside. I walked a little more than a mile, the crying still continued.When I reached the end of the bridge, I saw a tall iron city gate. As I walked out of the city gate, I suddenly woke up. That's when I realized I was lying in bed. Until then, the pitiful cry still echoed in my ears, unabated. When I calmed down, under the light of all the objects in the room, there was really nothing that could make a sound. Looking closely, the crying was very pitiful. Feeling unbearable pain and compassion, my tears flowed like a stream. I just woke up and realized that it was the pitiful cry of sentient beings suffering in hell. I then put on my robe and sat cross-legged and this sound stopped. The next day, I went to inform Dharma Master Dai Ngu. The monk said: "That is indeed the cry of sentient beings in distress in hell. You have made a vow and made the Ksitigarbha vow, so you feel that way. And when you hear those pitiful cries, you should be even more determined to practice. Your merit will soon be complete, so the sentient beings in hell will soon be freed from danger." I listened to the Great Master's instructions, and because I had made a vow in advance, I abandoned all thoughts and concentrated on practicing. I immediately quit my job and at the beginning of May went to the forest to meditate.

Co Ton Tin, the grandson of scholar Hua Vien Chieu, when he was two years old, he suffered from lymphadenopathy, which persisted for three years but was still not cured. All famous doctors are helpless. Listening to Hua Vien Chieu's words, he brought all his favorite things, according to the words in the Sutra, to Ton Tin and read them three times, so he sold those things for ten dong, then used that money to carve a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and respectfully worshiped it every day. Since then, Ton Tin's illness has gradually recovered, and now it has been three years without any minor colds. On the 2nd of March, the 16th year of the Republic of China (1927), I had the opportunity to visit Mr. Yuan Zhao in Shanghai to pay for his house and road, and I saw and heard this story with my own eyes.

● Ly Vien Tinh wrote.

Layman Cao Youbin, from Anhui, has been sick since childhood. My mother, Vi Thi, went to Tu Son mountain to pray, hoping for Bodhisattva's blessings so that my child's illness would be cured. Both mother and child sincerely bowed to Buddha. The Body of Body Tower is the Bodhisattva's sacred place. Every day, many good men and women come to burn incense and worship. In front of the tower is the Ten Kings Palace. Going down is Bach Ma Dinh, Hoa Thanh Tu, Release pond, winding hundreds of meters, the road is winding and winding, making it difficult for people to walk. Vi Thi made a vow, vowing to donate money to repair the road. When Vi Thi passed away, she told her child not to forget this matter.

Having been on this road for more than ten years now, Huu Tan has always listened to her mother's words, because the huge repair project has not yet been completed. On the second month of the year Mau Thin, the day of Quan Am Thanh Dan festival, Huu Tan went to worship at the Pagoda and worship at the Tower. After making offerings, Huu Tan went to the front of the Zen Hall to explore the scenery. Suddenly he saw Mother Vi Thi and a number of female servants, each carrying a bag, landing right in front of Huu Tan at the main gate, about ten steps away from Huu Tan. Huu Tan saw her mother very clearly, so she quickly walked closer, but in an instant she disappeared. Huu Tan then thought that the words Mother left behind at her death had not yet been completed, so the incarnation reminded her to repeat them. From then on, Huu Tan tried even harder to donate to soon fulfill Mother's wishes. Now the sacred mountains and scenic roads are dignified, it can be said to be filial, and to repay Buddha's favor to benefit sentient beings.

● Hua Chi Tinh writes.

Zhao Queqing, from Hefei, Anhui province, is a farmer but studious. The couple has been together for over 50 years and has only had one child named Ton Kim, who is studying in a private school. At the end of Fall that year, Ton Kim fell ill with the flu and passed away within a few days. Que Khanh and his wife cried deeply. One night, I dreamed that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva came to comfort me, saying: "Your child has returned to his body and soul. At the end of the year, you can come to the mountain and meet him." Khanh woke up, excited and excited, thinking that missing her child day and night made her feel foolish, the dream was unbelievable, but Bodhisattva's dream did not dare to ignore it.

In December of that year, the couple went to Trieu Son together. When they arrived in front of the Buddha hall, they suddenly saw a child running up, loudly calling for Mom and Dad. Asking their names and hometowns, they found out that these were Ton Kim and Trieu Nhi, two children who exchanged life and death. Although their appearance was different, their voices were still the same, and they said: "Thanks to the Bodhisattva's blessing, I was able to borrow my body and restore my soul." The couple was so happy that they took the child home, treating it like their own child. Hearing this, Trieu Nhi's parents did not agree, so the two sides disputed and sued. According to Ton Kim, he disguised himself as Trieu Nhi and did not want to return to his parents' house anymore. After everyone was reconciled, the two families got together and recognized the baby as their common child. That is a new ruling of the Trieu and Kim families. In the 9th year of the Republic of China (1920), offerings were made to a plaque titled "Boundless Buddha Dharma" to hang on Chieu Son mountain to commemorate this incident and when Huu Tan went up the mountain, he saw it. This is how the historical records record this matter.

● Hua Chi Tinh writes.

In February of the 33rd year of the Republic of China (1944), in the morning I went up to the Praise Tower to worship Buddha. At 8 p.m., go to the front hall where Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara is worshiped and chant the names of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. Because I wanted quiet, I turned off the light and stood at attention, clasped my hands facing the Buddha, chanted with my mouth and eyes focused, with a feeling of devotion in my heart as if it were daytime, then continued to chant the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva a thousand times. About the same number of times, I suddenly saw a bright light, as big as the mouth of a cup, shining like a lamp, three meters to the left of the statue of Avalokiteśvara. At first I thought it was someone holding a lamp walking through the garden, illuminating the wall. I turned my head to look out the window, saw that the moon had not yet come out, the campus was deserted, no one passed by, then I thought to myself maybe my eyesight was having problems, looking back at the old place the light had gone out and I couldn't see anything anymore. I returned to the old place to continue chanting, and saw the light rise again, but a little higher than last time. I just remembered that there is a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva there, the same shape as last year that my brother Tri Phuong drew to print and send to compatriots overseas and domestically, to spread the word for everyone to worship.Certain that it was the Bodhisattva's light, I quickly called my younger brother to come and see. When asked, my sister also had the same opinion. At that time, my father also walked in, chanted the Holy Name with us, and the light went out for a few minutes. In the past, my mother listened to the advice, and everyone in the hamlet was a layperson named Hang Tri Nguyen, who had been worshiping Buddha for more than 10 years. The whole family too, no one is not devoted to the Three Jewels, taking refuge with the Great Masters: An Quang, Tri Tung and Dieu Tran, for many years. My brothers and I have the desire to spread the Dharma to benefit. In January of this year, my mother got sick, her right arm could not move flexibly, and she had difficulty walking. My father had a tumor next to his chest and was looking for a cure. As for my brothers, why do we think this is happening? Knowing that due to bad karma, only Buddha's power can cure him, he worked even more diligently and sincerely recited the Sutra to pray for Buddha's blessing.

On the night of the 29th, my mother's tongue was stiff and she couldn't say anything, as if she had been hit by the wind. My brothers and I made a vow that, in addition to chanting the names of the Buddhas, we would also like to sincerely pray to read the Ksitigarbha Sutra. At the same time, on behalf of my Mother, I repent of my sins. The illness certainly seemed to gradually improve. From the day she got sick, day and night she devoutly chanted and recited the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, not in one day, to get the light last night, which was actually the epiphany of Bodhisattva. Therefore, my brothers' trust is even stronger. My whole family is very happy, confident that Mom and Dad's illness will be cured soon. The Bodhisattva's kindness truly makes us deeply grateful. The Prayer Sutra says: "If in the future there will be good men and good women who pray in this life or the next, with thousands of millions of millions of prayers, but must take refuge, pay respects and worship the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, then their wishes will be granted. Everything will be achieved." If anyone encounters a serious illness, they should respectfully worship Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and naturally the Bodhisattva will be willing to protect and save them. Respect His inconceivable merits. Everything depends on the heart of the worldly person in this life.

The day after Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's release day, in the second month of the year Giap Than. Disciple Duong Dong To, his dharma name is Nhan Sang Kinh Technique.

tieu_de: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Saint An Ky To Due Minh Female Scholar in Thuong Thuc
noi_dung:
Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Holy Grace

To Due Minh Female Scholar in Thuong Thuc

My family has a few members, only my aunt is a vegetarian and sincerely worships Buddhism. Although I believe that there are Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, I neglect to worship them. When my aunt passed away, the lay people in the commune came to help pray for her. The lay people and I have been going back and forth for a long time, so we gradually come to respect the Three Jewels. Tinh Hanh Lien Commune in Luc Uyen Tran has a Dharma Master Chinh Mong, who tries his best to promote Buddhism and wholeheartedly praise Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merits of saving suffering and suffering. He often advises members to read a lot of Ksitigarbha Sutras, they will certainly be inspired. It was the Dharma Master who initiated this. Within a few months, inspiration was indeed evident. Now I record the events to prove later that the Bodhisattva's premonition was truly unpredictable.

Story 1:

My daughter-in-law, who was pregnant after giving birth, has been suffering from mental disorders and has been talking nonsense for many days. Even the treatment she sought from Eastern and Western doctors was ineffective. Because I believed in Buddha and asked Dharma Master Chinh Mong for guidance, I gathered the lay people in the Pure Land Lotus Society to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra together. Having just finished reading the book Thuong, my daughter-in-law's illness suddenly recovered completely, and her mind regained consciousness as before. After reading the book Trung and Ha, my daughter-in-law slept well and her illness was completely cured.

Story 2:

The silversmith, surnamed Tien, has a strange disease, his neck is swollen, he can't eat or drink, and has been in pain and suffering for several days. He always shouted: "XXX (Name of a very devout Buddhist layperson in Tran village) is in heaven, I am in XXX hell, come quickly and save me." The patient's family invited a lay person and fellow members to read the Ksitigarbha Sutra. After reading it, the patient suddenly said: "Just now someone came to untie the rope so I wouldn't be hanged." The disease healed immediately.

Story 3:

The woman, surnamed Do, was seriously ill with typhoid. She invited Eastern and Western physicians to treat her, but her condition remained the same. Do Thi's entire family fasted and recited Buddha's name, and read the Ksitigarbha Sutra. After reading the sutra, the temperature drops, the disease gradually disappears, and then it is completely cured.

Story 4:

My mother, 79 years old, suddenly suffered from leprosy, her legs closed and she couldn't open them, in extreme pain. Lying in bed for a few years, she passed away. Then one night, I dreamed that my mother appeared and said, "My leg hurts." I just thought I remembered the dream too much so I didn't pay attention. One day while talking about this in Lien Xa, Master Chinh Mong advised reading the Ksitigarbha Sutra, which can pray for sinners to escape suffering. I then invited a Taoist monk to chant together. On the 6th day, I dreamed that my mother said: "I have escaped suffering." On the 7th day, after reading the Sutra, I dreamed again that Mother was going to the West. I even went to say goodbye... There! We see that the Bodhisattva's power can liberate the sufferings of people in darkness. How good!

tieu_de: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Saint Prestige Phuong Duc Hue
noi_dung:
Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Holy Prescription

Phuong Duc Hue

In the spring of the 34th year of the Republic of China (1945), the war to invade the puppet enemy was fierce, and Buxiaozi was serving his mother in Shanghai. My sister was also in Shanghai at that time. My father was busy in Tran Giang at that time. On April 28, the 17th day of the third lunar month, I received a telegram from Tran Giang, saying that my Father was seriously ill. I then discussed it with Mother and she went to visit Father. My mother thinks that nowadays traffic is inconvenient, bus tickets are expensive and difficult to buy, and there are a lot of thieves and robbers there, so women and children should not go. Therefore, the trip was unsuccessful.

Every time I remember Father, my heart is confused. The next day I went to her house to discuss this matter, and stayed overnight, with my grandchild in a room. In that area, the lighting management is very strict, the electricity is turned off at 10 o'clock. Before 10 o'clock we went to bed. Because I was concerned about Father, I couldn't sleep. The bedroom is on the 3rd floor, there are windows front and back, looking towards the back window you can see bright moonlight. As I fell asleep, I suddenly saw a crowd of people coming, then stopped outside the door. Only my Father turned the crowd into the house. I was about to ask when my Father stood still in front of the bed, calling my name in a very pitiful voice: "My life is over, I'm about to leave, do you know?" Hearing the words knowing that something was wrong, my face was haggard, I didn't know what to say, the only way was to sobly comfort him: "I already know, Dad, don't be sad, life and death have a destiny. No one can maintain the human body forever, except for Buddha's power, there is no way to escape. That's why I advise you every day to recite the Buddha's name. Even though you didn't listen, making a vow to take refuge, one thought of kindness, is not in vain. Please listen to what I said. child”.

My father said with a gloomy face, "It's getting late, I'll go with everyone," then pointed out the door. The people waiting outside also looked in, seemingly urging. My father turned and said to the crowd: "Everyone is waiting for me, please wait a few more minutes, because I still have a few words to say to my daughter." After saying that, Father turned back and said to me: "Hue Nhi! I need to read the Buddha's Recitation Sutra to be liberated. I regret not listening to your advice on weekdays." He said, then looked out at the crowd and said, "I'll be there soon." Then said, "I'm going, remember to recite Buddha's name and pray for my salvation." He said and walked away. I quickly asked my Father if he had anything else to say? My father turned around and said, "There's nothing else worth talking about. Remember to recite Buddha's name and pray for me." Then he covered his face with both hands as if wiping away tears. And I couldn't hold back two streams of tears falling. As I walked out the door, my Father looked back and said, "I'm waiting for your prayers." Suddenly, in the crowd outside the door, there was a person holding an object like a rope and threw it at my Father. I was very heartbroken, so I raised my hand and said, "This man is my Father." I serve Buddha Dharma and am confident that I can ask Buddha's power to absolve my Father of his sins.My father probably won't stay in the dark realm for long. In just a month, he will definitely be liberated. I would like to thank you for your kindness." That person indeed loosened his hand and left with my Father and everyone.

Everything that happened didn't alarm anyone, so I woke up my grandchild and saw that he was sleeping soundly. My brother-in-law is a very shy person. As for my sister, she has always been proud of being a non-superstitious person. I kept this a secret, but knowing for sure that Father had passed away, I couldn't sleep all night, so I recited Buddha's name. The next morning I woke up early and went back to the school. My classmate gave me a telegram saying he had just received it last night. After translating it, my eyes were filled with tears. The telegram said that my Father passed away last night. My heart hurts like hell.

From that day I started reading the Buddha's Recitation Sutra. Although I have taken refuge for several years, I have never read the Ksitigarbha Sutra and worshiped the names of the Buddhas. Now, for the sake of the Immortals, I ask for your favor. Now I pray to Buddha and the title of Bodhisattva. Sincerely bow and pray. On February 25, it had been 8 days since Father died. That night, while I was kneeling and chanting, I suddenly saw a beam of light pointing towards the Northeast, as long as a strip of cloth. I saw my Father kneeling there, chanting day and night. Everyone saw that light, at first only saw my Father kneeling there and worshiping. The light gets farther and farther away every day. After that, more and more people came to pay their respects every day. There were people wearing clothes like those of the Quan family who also prostrated themselves and bowed. In the light, a strange thing was that the light pointed to the Northeast direction, nothing could be seen in other directions.

April 8, the day of the Buddha's Nativity, during the day I set up the altar to offer fruits, flowers, and chant, and saw in the light many people worshiping, just like every day. In the evening, as usual, I recited the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, when suddenly I saw the Bodhisattva appear holding a staff and sticking it into the ground, with light radiating into a large area. The power causes the earth to move for a long time. My limbs trembled, unable to control myself. In the light, there were many people jumping happily, some running around, some flying up into the sky, as if experiencing joy. At that time, the Buddha Light was so bright that it was impossible to see up close. At that time, everyone was in a commotion, some were flying up to the sky, some were running in disarray, some were leisurely, some were in a hurry. Looking closely, I could not find out what my father was like. After reciting the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra and claiming his title, I next recited the Buddha's name and claimed his Holy name. Then I looked closely and could no longer see the light in the Northeast. In my heart I was grateful and thought to myself, My father must have been saved thanks to Buddha's grace. It has been exactly three weeks since my Father passed away, less than a month.Buddha's grace is wide and deep, Buddha's power is immense, it is truly immeasurable. With mixed joy and happiness, all I can do is bow my head and give thanks.

On the 9th morning, I woke up and chanted as usual. Suddenly looking to the west, I saw a row of low houses, about a few hundred rooms. Although the houses are small and narrow, they are very neat and tidy, connected one after another like a village. About 3 acres away, there is a small, isolated house with no neighboring houses on all four sides, but the walls are still new. My father was probably there, walking around the house. Thinking that my Father's coffin was in this place, I looked at the neighboring houses and they were in a Catholic cemetery. At that time, because times were not peaceful, they did not dare to be buried there, so they asked an acquaintance to buy a piece of land in that area, so that later in peacetime, they could move the coffin back to the original place for burial. That place is next to a Catholic cemetery, so it had to be that way.

From then on, I sincerely prayed, hoping that my Father would give thanks to Buddha for his grace, strengthen his faith, and maintain good thoughts. Not long after, I saw my Father prostrate on the ground. From then on, every time I prayed, I saw my Father in that small house. If I saw his shadow, it was when he prostrated himself. Such a quick response is truly unpredictable. What a strange thing. On the 9th day, after I finished reciting, I took out the map to look at it. I learned that Tran Giang was indeed in the West of Khiet Bo, proving that it was not an exaggeration. On March 25, I saw Phat Quang appear again in the Northeast. At that time I really didn't understand what it meant. One day, when I opened the book Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Spiritual Inspiration Book, I learned that during the Tang Dynasty, when Duong Chau Doc Buu Dang Ton passed away, the messenger who led him to hell was in the Northeast. Only then did I realize that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva had a Tathagata Staff that could open the nine gates of the underworld. Now I prove that this event is true, the divine power of Buddha Dharma is truly inconceivable.

Three Jewels disciple Phuong Duc Hue
