tieu_de: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Holy Virtue Ky Khuong Tri Thanh
noi_dung:
Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Holy Duc Ky

Khuong Tri Thanh

In July, the fall of the Year of the Dog, my sister fell seriously ill with typhoid. All doctors are at a loss. Just as I was visiting the sick nearby, I saw the book Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Prayer Sutra, which states that if you sell precious items such as clothes to get money to make statues or paintings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, or if the karma person should be sick, but thanks to the merits mentioned above, the illness will be cured and life will be increased. If I make a vow to ask a substitute to donate money and show me the Nine Flowers Mountain Square Sacrifice Temple, donate a little to help cast the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and advise my sister to pray like that, then I will be able to sail with the wind. Then the fever is reduced, the person is alert, and the illness is less, seven or eight percent less. The people standing around thought it was strange.

One ​​morning seven days later, my sister saw an Old Monk, holding a tin stick in his hand, slowly walking into the living room and standing next to the bed. My sister clasped her hands respectfully, but was nowhere to be seen. From then on, my sister felt her weak limbs and mental fatigue suddenly disappear completely. It is known that the Bodhisattva protects the six paths and saves those with love, supernatural powers and inconceivable virtue. After recovering from her illness, she made up her mind to practice pure karma, chanting the name of the Bodhisattva day and night, taking the six-month fast every month, giving advice to everyone she met, and asked me to write the Spirit of Inspiration for everyone to know, so that we can generate righteous faith and cultivate good roots.

Khuong Tri Thanh registers.

tieu_de: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Holy Grace and Enlightenment
noi_dung:
Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Holy Grace

Giac Thuan

In the past, I became a monk because I was sick. From the day I became a monk until now, I have not had any serious illness. Sometimes when the four elements are not in harmony, I rest and sit and meditate and meditate on the Dharma, my illness will be cured immediately. In the spring of this year, the 36th year of the Republic of China (1947), I went to Hangzhou on a pilgrimage. Along the way, I saw the Buddha's room. At the bottom of the boat, I set up a Taoist temple and chanted non-stop day and night. The small boat carried many people, it was hot inside, cold outside, so when I got home I felt tired, but I didn't pay attention.

It wasn't until April 23 that I felt seriously ill, 10 days without a grain of rice or a drop of water in my stomach. On the night of the 30th, his illness was critical, and he saw Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva holding a Tin Staff in one hand and a Bowl in the other, standing in front of the hospital bed and saying: "Recite Buddha with peace of mind." The next morning, I felt better.

By May 5, I could eat porridge, and by Buddha's Birthday, I was completely cured. Now, thanks to the Dafaun Shu Bureau, we have published the 100-volume book Ksitigarbha's History of Cause and Effect to repay the special gratitude and record this matter.

The twelve stories above are excerpted from

Nguyet San Giac Huu Tinh

tieu_de: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Inspiration Ky Ngo Kinh Nhan
noi_dung:
Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Premonitions

Ngo Kinh Nhan

Layman Hoang Duc Xuan, from Ningbo, in Shanghai, Bo Dong Chau area, Y Trang street, has opened a shop selling votive items called Di Nguyen for several decades. In the past, lay people took refuge with Dharma Master An Quang, diligently chanted the Diamond Sutra every day, and kept the six pearls very carefully. Lately, I've been busy with work so I don't see each other very often. On the occasion of Bo Lien Xa's celebration of Amitābha Buddha's death on November 20, I went to the post office to send a letter. The new officiant told the master: "The lay person next to him has been sick since last winter, so the Diamond Sutra and the six precepts that have been maintained for several years have neglected and broken the precepts. Therefore, the soul wanders into the underworld, crying and suffering day and night. He invited the Taoist to perform a dispelling spell, but it was ineffective. You are a brother, so you should visit him and see if he can still recognize you."

The honorable man went to Mr. Hoang Duc Xuan's house to visit. He only heard the sound of crying, so he went to the hospital bed and asked: "Do you still recognize me?" Mr. Hoang Duc Xuan said: "You are my brother, please come and save me. I am suffering a lot in hell", his words were babbling, he looked like he was in a coma. On the table, bones and flesh were messy. The respectable person then scolded him that he should not eat these foods, and advised him to wholeheartedly recite Buddhist scriptures and seek birth in the West. The Venerable helped him recite the prayer together for a while but it was ineffective. Think back to when Dear Mother used to be sick and in a similar coma. Immediately welcome the monks to read the Buddhist scriptures and recite the Earth Store Vow to be cured. Then he advised the family of layperson Hoang Duc Xuan to invite monks to read the 7 sets of Ksitigarbha Sutra, and recite Ksitigarbha's holy name ten thousand times, and they will be blessed by the Bodhisattva to cure his illness. Then Kinh Nhan said goodbye and left. On December 6, the day of Lien Xa's Festival, respectful people came to attend the meeting and heard layperson Tran Gia Tuan say: "The layperson Hoang has been waiting for him for many days. Because of his illness, thanks to the Bodhisattva's blessing, he has now completely recovered. After reading the 7 volumes, it is very effective. Now that he has read all 108 volumes, his spirit is getting better and better, he is as healthy as an ordinary person.Now bring the gold watch and add some money to ask him to carve a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to make offerings to Vinh Dinh Pagoda and Chau Bo Lien Xa. From now on, I wholeheartedly recite Buddha's and Bodhisattva's holy names, currently help with the printing and production costs, recite the ten steps every month and progress to the long path, and I look forward to you coming to meet him."

When Kinh Nhan came to see him, he clasped his hands in gratitude and recounted the Bodhisattva's inspiration, recounted his wish and asked him to write the Inspiration Note to express the Bodhisattva's Holy Virtues. Kinh Nhan then recorded this incident, hoping that everyone would have the same faith, to make the Bodhisattva's great vow to save all sentient beings complete, which is a blessing for society and this method is truly rare (Written in March 33 (1944) Hoang Hoa Nguyet San.

tieu_de: Pray to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to know the name of Father Dat Thanh
noi_dung:
Praying for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

To Know Your Father's Name

Dat Thanh

At the age of 3, he lost his parents, changed his name and went to live. When I became a monk at the age of 24, I still didn't know who my parents were. Now I live at the Buddha's door. I often think about the suffering of not knowing my parents' names and not being able to return home. Recently, when he met Pho Da Hong Phat Duong, he learned that on April 18, there was a U Minh Dai Gioi Buddhist event. Du then asked Abbot Chieu Cong, because he did not know the names of his Parents, so he could not pray for the deceased. Hearing this, Du felt even more sad. Then he asked further: "Is there any other method that can be saved?" Chieu Cong said that the only way is to be sincere and earnest, to pray to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to reveal the names of his parents, and to try, there is no other way. Yu then did as he was told, and earnestly prayed before the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. At the hour of the Rat, day and night 17, I dreamed of seeing a piece of paper with Father's name Kim Chung Lien written on it, three words. I was so happy that I woke up. The next morning, Vu went to tell Cong Chieu and all the monks who heard this news thought it was strange. Great Bodhisattva Vows Great Power according to his wishes. Today I tell this story so that people in the same situation can pray.Bodhisattva is very compassionate, depending on the wishes of living beings, except for those whose hearts are not sincere, and contrary to the Buddha's wishes, they are afraid it will be difficult to be inspired. If you truly have the heart to pray, follow Buddha's teachings, believe and pray, you will naturally be inspired.

( 33rd July (1944) according to Hoang Hoa

Nguyet San )

tieu_de: Lac Thanh Buddhist Lay Buddhist Ksitigarbha Association of Premonitions of Light and Visualization Technique
noi_dung:
Lac Thanh Buddhism

Lay Buddhist Ksitigarbha Association

Instincts

Pho Quang Thi Thoai

On July 24, Year of the Ox (1949), the Luo Qing Hong Kieu Ksitigarbha Association was first established. The founders were Trieu Thuong Hoa, Truong Trong San, Quy Thach Than, Vuong Mong Han, Trinh Ky Xuan, Thuong Chi Khoan, etc. Starting from that day, Ksitigarbha Buddha's retreat is often celebrated. The motto is to pray for the local people to have peace. In the morning, recite the Bodhisattva's name. At 2:00 p.m., invite layperson Ho Thien Boc to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, dividing it into 7 days to complete the reading. Every day, over thousands of believers come to listen to the scripture reading, it is very bustling. On the night of the 24th, recite the Sutra from 8 o'clock until the cock crows. At that time, surrounding residents saw a bright light, shining straight into the roof of Lam's palace. It seemed like there was a patrol light in the passing area. Seeing that light, they suspected there was something unusual, so they climbed up the wall to observe and saw that the temple was quiet and there was no sound, only the light in front of the altar was dimly emitted. Tuan Tieu was surprised, 4-5 nights in a row had such light. Although Tuan Tieu was suspicious, he could not explain it. During seven days, someone came to investigate, but found no clue.

On the 1st day of the seventh lunar month, the Dharma Assembly had not yet ended. Tuan Tieu came to find out the reason for the light, but the person in charge of the Dharma Assembly only honestly replied that he did not understand the reason. But they still didn't believe it, so they let people search the surrounding houses, but there was nothing strange. Layperson Truong Van said that Dao Trang radiating light is everywhere, there is nothing strange. This light appearing is probably Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva emitting light to show good omens. From then on, you guys stopped patrolling and didn't investigate this matter anymore. Everyone was surprised. Because of the light of inspiration, the lay people firmly believed and the membership increased to more than 300 people. Everyone knows that the Bodhisattva emits light. Villages in Lac Dong first and later established Ksitigarbha Dharma Assembly in three places: One is at Tho Xuong Co Tu in Dam Khe village, two is at Quang Ung Tu in Vong Hanh village, and third is Nam Bo Son Ksitigarbha Temple. Each association has about 1 to 200 people. Buddhism in Lac Dong is so popular thanks to the cause and effect of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's light.

tieu_de: Dreaming of Someone Asking for Your Head
noi_dung:
Dreaming of Someone Asking for Your Head

The hamlet has a person named Tu Doan Vuong, a Christian. When Mother passed away, his friend advised him to read and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra. At first, Tu didn't think anything of it. Slowly, he didn't know what to do. Then he thought that he couldn't repay his parents' gratitude, so he thought about what his Buddhist friend said and thought it was reasonable, so he vowed to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra. His body was sick and could not be cured. One night he dreamed that an old man came to him and told him that he should decoct a watermelon vine and drink it and his illness would be cured. So he hired someone to use a camphor tree to carve three holy statues at Moc Tieu Tu.

One night he dreamed again that someone came to demand three heads. He found it strange that he did not feel secure early in the afternoon. A few days later, a monk from Muc Tieu Tu came to say that the Buddha statue had been carved, but three heads were still missing. The Tu family finally understood, so they found more camphor wood to carve enough. From then on, he wholeheartedly worshiped Buddha and chanted non-stop.

Dangerous Illness Cured

Layman Vuong Kinh Hoa, Chairman of the Nam Bo Dharma Association, has a child who is seriously ill, and has been lying in bed for several months, unable to get up, and the medicine is ineffective. On the seventh day of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, he single-mindedly took care of everything at the Dharma assembly and did not return home to take care of his children. Standing before the Buddha statue, making a vow is to wholeheartedly take the propagation of Buddhism as one's responsibility, and wholeheartedly pray for one's child to be cured of his illness. One day a neighbor came to tell the layman that his son's illness had completely recovered. The layperson did not believe in such a miracle, so he hurried home to visit his child. He saw that his child had recovered and was walking around in the front yard, asking for food and drink. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's premonition is truly so quick.

Rescue from the Abyss

On the 1st day of the seventh lunar month last year, in Luo Qing, Nam Dang Tran, at the Ksitigarbha Temple in Nam Bo Son, Ksitigarbha Thu Su Chu Loc Minh and Chau Van Toan, two lay people, because the Assembly radiated strange light, started to celebrate the Ksitigarbha Buddha's Chamber, inviting the Dharma Master of the Assembly to preside. Accompanying him was lay practitioner Lam Hao preaching the Ksitigarbha Sutra, to an audience of over six hundred people.

That electricity was built on Nam Bo Son, drinking water had to be carried down the mountain, up and down there were over 600 steps, the road was winding and difficult. At that time, there was an old man who made a vow that drinking water for the 7 days of the Dharma conference would be provided by him alone. The weather is hot, there are many people, every day we have to use more than 20 barrels. When the rooster crowed in the morning of the 2nd day, he got up to fetch water. It was raining and the road was slippery. He slipped and fell down the mountain. Suddenly, it was as if someone with strength was next to him to save him. At that time, he was still breathing heavily when he suddenly saw someone coming to save him, so he said thank you, but no one answered. He calmly looked back and saw that all around was deserted without a shadow of anyone. He only saw the lantern at the end of the pole radiating light, so he told this story to everyone. Everyone who heard it was surprised. Dharma Master De Nhat told everyone: "Fortunately, Ksitigarbha appeared to save your life, otherwise the honor of the Dharma Assembly would have been damaged. Because you vowed to carry water to provide for everyone, your merit is very great, so in danger, Bodhisattva saved your life."

Dreaming of Bodhisattva

The Master of the Ksitigarbha Dharma Assembly is a lay person. Every day, I often do good deeds and carefully read the Ksitigarbha Sutra, knowing that hell is very painful and filled with fear. There is a sentence in the Sutra that if you want to know where your parents are, you should read the Ksitigarbha Prayer Sutra and you will receive guidance from the Bodhisattva. The layperson then vowed to fast and recite the Buddha's name. 30 days later, he dreamed of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva sitting on a lotus flower. Light radiated and illuminated everywhere. The solemn Dharma voice told layperson Ly that his parents were still in Minh Do and led him to a place. He saw his parents sitting in the temple, holding a rosary and reciting sutras, not saying anything. The rooster crowed and the lay people quickly woke up, burned incense in front of the Buddha statue, prayed for their parents to soon return to the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, and vowed to live a vegetarian life without killing. Every day, no matter how busy you are, you read Ksitigarbha Sutra once, and vow to propagate Buddha Dharma to save suffering sentient beings. Over the past few years, lay people have continuously founded the Ksitigarbha Dharma Conference. Now the merits of Ly lay people have contributed greatly.

Death and Birth

Layman Trieu Gia Cau, from Cu Do, Thien Thanh village, was a great believer in Buddha. He was very sad when his child was lost. During the time of pain, the lay person made a vow to liberate his child, recited the name and recited the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra ten thousand times, then it seemed like he saw his child's body stand up, slowly floating up high, wearing a fur coat, his feet walking lightly, very clearly. When you look closely, you can't see it anymore. Millions of lay people saw this and were very surprised. They believed it was a Bodhisattva premonition. They learned that their child had already been born in Heaven. There was no doubt about it anymore.

tieu_de: Dreaming of Seeing a Dharma General
noi_dung:
Dreaming of Seeing a Dharma General

In Dong Ban Tran street, there was a man named Lam Hien Phap, who never believed in Buddha. One day he dreamed of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva descending from the sky, wearing a robe and wearing a Lotus Flower crown, Uy Dung Hien Hach. He did not dare to look straight, but saw a couplet next to him: One Word Against Dog, One Word for One Word. The Lam family did not know the meaning. The next day when they asked people, they found out that it was the word Hell, followed by Hell of No Emptiness. Only vaguely remembering that, only then did they know that the Bodhisattva became a saint. From then on, he made a vow to recite the Buddha's name, and participated in a meeting to practice Buddhism very diligently.

Carries Water That Doesn't Dry

Hong Kieu layperson Lam, only a few steps away from Tinh Tam Temple, the monks in the Temple specialize in practicing Pure Land. Morality is very strict, everyone respects it. Tue Trac and Duy Tay are two noble people who are loved by everyone. In the pagoda there is a pond to release animals, the water in the pond is always full. After releasing animals, the natives all came to the water to catch fish for profit. The monks in the temple came and said it was difficult, please don't drain the water from the pond. They did not listen but came together to splash water in larger numbers than before, from morning to afternoon. It was impossible to drain a meter of water, and the water tanker was greatly damaged. Everyone was surprised that the water in the pond did not dry up. They knew that there was a reason why it did not dry up, so they told each other to stop splashing water in that pond.

Eliminating Nightmares

Ms. Tiet Ky Cao's house is in Tran village, next to the house of layperson Trieu Thuong Hoa. Mrs. Tiet often has nightmares at night and screams loudly. Neighbors are often disturbed and cannot sleep peacefully. Trieu layperson told Ms. Tiet that in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, there is a saying that if you have nightmares at night when you sleep, you should recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra's name ten thousand times and it will naturally go away. Ms. Tiet said: "If it is true, I will try it." She began chanting Amitābha Buddha's holy name day and night. From then on, she suddenly no longer had nightmares.

tieu_de: Female Artist Duong Nhuoc Lan engraved Ksitigarbha's Ten Rings Sutra with Inspiration
noi_dung:
Duong Nhuoc Lan Nu Si

Carving Ksitigarbha Ten Chakra Sutra

Autobiographical Inspiration

10th year of the Republic of China (1921) Mother was seriously ill. She was working at the Beijing Women's Pedagogical Institute. Less than 10 days after returning home, she passed away. Because of the chaos, we did not pray for salvation. When she was 13 years old, she went to elementary school in Tu Chau and dreamed that her mother wanted to become a vegetarian. It was exactly three years to the day. In the 14th year (1925), she went to the Eastern Great Monastery Buddha Hall. In the 15th year, she fasted for a long time. In the 16th year, she read the Ksitigarbha Sutra. She dreamed of her mother and told her to enter the Ksitigarbha. In the 30th year of her father's death, the female scholar read Ksitigarbha Sutra and dreamed that her father also entered Ksitigarbha. In the year 31, Mom and Dad passed 80 days. According to the instructions of the Chinh Cuong Dharma Master, they carved two volumes of the Ten Wheel Sutra.

Over 40 Years of Close Premonition

Winter Tuyen Thong Nguyen Year of the Qing Dynasty, Mr. She gave birth to her child and then fell into a coma, lost consciousness, and could not speak for two days and nights. Mr. X sat next to the bed, not knowing what to do. The patient suddenly opened his mouth and called his name and his son said: "Quickly bow to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva." He then asked: "Where is Bodhisattva?" His wife replied that she was at the table right by the window. He quickly bowed. After bowing, the patient opened his eyes and was alert and speaking as usual. Mr. His wife replied that she was wearing a white robe with a swastika embroidered on it. A year later, his wife made a robe embroidered with a swastika, and he personally brought it to Pho Da Pagoda. When Doctor Ngu Dinh Phuong was on the same boat, he heard him talk about the benefits of vegetarianism. From then on he did not eat any meat. That is also a strange fate. His wife listened to my Mother's words, every month on the 9th, fasted and burned incense to celebrate Quan Am. When his mother was seriously ill, his wife cut her own flesh to make medicine. With such sincerity and filial piety, he was saved by the Great Master's epiphany. This is a real story, not a coincidence.

In the 13th year of the Republic (1924), because his career failed, he closed his mind and read the Diamond Sutra and the Avalokiteshvara Sutra every day. He was alone, in a room on the third floor, with very bright glass windows. The room, except for a table and chair for reading the scripture, was empty and had no other objects. One day, while he was reading the Sutra without worrying about anything, he smelled the scent of incense, but did not see the incense burner. After reading the Sutra, he went through the room where the ancestral altar was located. He did not see anyone burning incense. That was the first time he smelled the scent of Agarwood.

In the 15th Republic (1926), in the first lunar month, he came to Suzhou and stayed at the house of layman Ly Ba Nong. The layman taught him to recite seven mantras, and told him: "These mantras are extremely powerful. If you recite them often, you will get many benefits." On Nguyen Tieu night, he and the lay people went for a walk in the garden. This place was sparsely populated and all were vegetable growers. At this time, every house was closed and quiet, without a sound. He was chanting some newly learned spells. When he reached the bridge, he suddenly smelled the scent of incense, and there was no house around. He then asked layperson Ly: "Do you smell the scent?" The layman replied: "Smelling it, you must be chanting a mantra. This scent is different from Agarwood incense, it is the induction of the mantra."

In the 15th year of the Republic (1926), every morning, I and layperson Ngo Giac So read the Avatamsaka Sutra, chapter Samantabhadra's Prayer. Pho Quan Han, who works at Hang Phong textile factory, also came to chant with us. One day in winter, while we were chanting Sutras, we suddenly smelled the scent of cinnamon flowers. At that time, the four people chanting the Sutra all smelled it. After reciting the Sutra, ask the people in the house and everyone can smell the scent of cinnamon flowers. In fact, there is nothing in the house that can radiate the scent of cinnamon flowers.

In the 17th year of the Republic, I had just finished reading the Sutras and bowing before the altar with the statue of the Great Master, then went upstairs to my Mother's room to say goodbye. My mother said: "You just lit incense, it smells very fragrant, this scent is definitely not an ordinary incense." I answered of course because it was Agarwood incense. But strangely, why does my mother smell the fragrance of incense? Because my mother has been suffering from a stuffy nose for more than ten years now, she can't feel anything so she can't smell anything. I asked my mother: "Yesterday I was in the next room mixing medicine with musk and mothballs in it. Did you smell anything?". My mother answered no. I said: "At the altar upstairs, I burned incense to pray for Mother. It must be the inspiration of the Bodhisattva." My mother was very happy after hearing this. Because from my Mother's room to the room where the altar was placed, I had to walk around, but my Mother could still smell the fragrance of incense. Besides the Bodhisattva's epiphany, there is no other reason.

In the 16th year of the Republic (1927), I and layperson Quach Ham Trai went to Pho Da Pagoda, then to A Duc Vuong Pagoda to worship the relics. First, go to Thien Dong Tu to worship Buddha. Thien Dong is a famous ancient Taoist school. It's also close to Duc Vuong Temple. At the end of the Qing Dynasty, the monk Bat Chi Dau Da abbot lived at this pagoda. Bat Chi Dau Da comes from a farmer's family. Dau Da's father was a tenant of layman Quach Ham Trai. When we were young, lay people played together with Dau Da. When he grew up, Dau Da often came to play with the monks, then asked to become a disciple. He was not allowed to go to school. He only stayed at the temple to learn how to read the Sutras and then become literate. He was also stupid in nature. He was very surprised because his understanding of the meaning of the Sutras was limited. Dau Da then went to Putuo Pagoda and to Duc Vuong Tu to pray to Xa Loi to expand his wisdom and stayed at Duc Vuong Tu for several years.

On Buddha's birthday, Dau Da burned two fingers to worship Buddha, so there were only eight fingers left, so it was called Bat Chi Dau Da. A year later, still seeing that his mind had not been cleared, Dau Da cut the meat from his shoulder, used the fat to light a lamp, and then went to Truong Sa. When passing through Dinh Ho Cave, Dau Da went to Nhac Duong Lau and saw a poem on the wall: "Ba Tong Nhat Tang Lai Cave". When he came to Truong Sa to meet a monk, Dau Da took that verse and asked about it. That monk said: "The poem is very good, you will become a poet in the future", and taught him how to read three hundred Tang poems. Before, Dau Da had not studied any ancient poetry, but after returning to Duc Vuong Tu, he began to understand a lot of the classic books, recite them accordingly, and was praised by the monks. And Dau Da began practicing asceticism, eating whatever food was left over in the kitchen, without abstaining from anything.

Since then Dau Da has been famous as a good poet. At the end of the Qing Dynasty, the famous poet Vuong Quan Nhiem often came to sing. After Dau Da went to Thien Dong Tu in Ninh Ba to become Phuong Truong, more than ten years later he passed away. Outside the gate of Thien Dong Tu, a tower was built to commemorate. Next to the tower are three pagodas, including Dau Da statue. I went to the pagoda to listen to the Sutra lecture, while layman Quach went to Dau Da tower to recite Buddha's name for more than two hours, saying he was visiting an old friend.

The pagoda has trees planted over a mile long. We entered the tree line. Layman Quach walked more than ten steps ahead. He looked ahead and looked back and asked me: "Do you smell the fragrance?". I answer no? "Going ten more steps, he turned around and asked: "Do you smell the fragrance?" I said no? Walked another dozen steps. Then Mr. Quach told me that the fragrance wafted from here to the end of the tree line before stopping, that was Dau Da's premonition.

From ancient times until now, there have been many people who have been enlightened by the Zen Master, some of whom have had their wisdom enlightened. Dau Da practiced asceticism and gained wisdom. People from the past who had not gone to school knew how to write poetry, and the rhyme of poetry was very high. It's a difficult thing, very rare. After Dau Da's death, poet Tran Tan Nguyen engraved it in Dau Da's poetry collection, and Vuong Nham Thu's preface wrote: "Dau Da's poetic style is very high, comparable to many famous works in Tang poetry." The following year, he added: "My preface said that Dau Da's poetry is compared to Duong Thi's work. Now that I think about it, it is not true, because many authors' poetry is not as good as Dau Da's." Both prefaces are engraved in Dau Da's poetry collection.

That's enough to know that Dau Da's poetry is very commendable. The path of writing poetry is not easy for ordinary people to understand. Qing dynasty contests also had many poets. The Academy writes poetry with the main focus being correct, while the poetic words are labored and reluctantly collected, in the eyes of the poets they cannot really be published in the Great Court. As for Dau Da's poetry, at first it was not very good, but it became good poetry because he later read many ancient poems. Because he was uneducated, he did not know many classics to apply. The best part is in the innocent descriptions and realistic situations, so there are many good rhymes and high style. Lam Ngu Duong, a new writer, wrote: "Out of ten good poets, nine of them are Buddhist scholars."

After being enlightened by Zen Buddhism, one can open one's mouth to discuss the wonderful teachings. There is nothing wrong with eloquence, not beyond the words of Prajna. The display of that premonition scent can tell that Dau Tuo has achieved very high achievements, and is on par with the poets of the Jin Dynasty and Wei Luc from the Tang Dynasty onwards. Nine out of ten people are Buddhist thinkers, or have inherited beliefs, complete with Buddhist studies and connections to Chinese poetry and literature. The point of Buddhism is to eliminate ego and that practice is beginningless and endless. Except for ego, the true nature is revealed. Layman Quach and I went to Duc Vuong to pay our respects to Xa Loi. (The Buddha's body, after cremation, is formed into small pellets). Two years ago I came to worship once. The relics are placed in the Tower, with a slit next to it so we can see. The relics are as large as a peppercorn and are attached to a yellow gong-shaped piece of metal hanging in the middle. Before, we saw a tray with yellow relics attached. This time we saw that the piece of metal holding the relic was dark blue. We suspect it's a bad omen. Then we repented together. That evening we bowed together about ten times.When we woke up the next morning, we went to worship and saw that the tray had changed to yellow. Compared to two years ago, we see no difference. I thought the relics attached to the golden metal were yellow, but why did they change to dark blue yesterday? This morning it changed to yellow again. Devotees such as monks, nuns, and lay people come to worship the relics in large numbers every day. After finishing worshiping, a Truc Dien Sangha came and led everyone out into the yard. They knelt before the altar and saw that each person saw different colors. Some people see white, some see red, some see black, some don't see anything, ask many people but they all give different answers, no one sees the same thing. That's probably because I see different colors depending on my karma.

Proof of Reincarnation

Thirty-two years ago, a German-Jewish physician named Woff, along with Physician Van, came to talk to me, saying he wanted to study Buddhism. I said that a ten-foot high building must be built from the foundation. Buddhism is profound and profound, we need to start talking about the Six Paths of Samsara. Mr. Woff said I believed in the theory of reincarnation. I asked why, and Mr. Woff told me that a few years ago in Germany, there was a woman who could speak a language that no one understood. Later, when a university professor specializing in the study of ancient writing came to research, it was discovered that this woman used the writing of the Aramaisch people. This text has been lost for more than a thousand years, but there are still people who can preserve the poetry. This woman does not have a college education, but naturally knows how to speak this language, so it is assumed that she is a reincarnated person of this ethnic group, so she can remember the language of her past. It is a proof of reincarnation. At that time I remember Mr. Woff writing me Aramaisch to write in my notebook. Last year, Mr. Woff passed away but his autograph still exists today.To base my theory on, Dr. Ho Tuyen Minh often told me that in the US, there was a patient who was drugged and lying in a hospital. One day he suddenly spoke Latin. When he woke up and asked him, he didn't understand anything because he had never studied Latin. Psychologists explain that it is the effect of the subconscious mind. But where does this subconscious mind come from, if it doesn't know this language from a previous life, it is a reincarnated soul? And where does this subconscious mind come from?

Psychologists cannot predict with certainty. But Buddhism says that everyone has Stored Consciousness. It is also called the Eighth Consciousness. That means people have always been infected with habits, in hidden consciousness. Every human being has wisdom, stupid, foolish or wise, which cannot be regular. It's all because it was hidden from the previous life and only revealed in this life. That is the logical explanation of the subconscious mind. In Brazil, there was a poor child who, at the age of twelve, suddenly knew a language that no one knew, and could translate it into Portuguese, with very correct grammar. This child has never studied Portuguese literature. Brazilian psychologists tried to understand, but could not explain, they could only say: "Knowledge brought from previous lives."

In recent years, European and American scholars have become more and more confident in Buddhism. Buddhism's theory of reincarnation makes this issue an object of study. Spanish spiritualists, the International Association of Reincarnation, began collecting evidence for the truth about reincarnation in Buddhism in the summer of 1935. The special issue of Buddhism in the UK also has an essay discussing this incident. The content of the essay is excerpted as follows: "Evidence of reincarnation has long been known to exist, but I wonder if it can negate that perception of "determination"? For example, there have been many children who can talk about past lives. After investigation, it has been proven to be true. There are also hypnotists who have been able to make hypnotized people remember past life stories. It can be proven that they can speak the language of their past lives. Let's ask about facts such as So, is it considered decisive evidence? Haman, a German Doctor, also has the following text: All arguments and proofs on all aspects, proving the theory of reincarnation have been thoroughly recorded in books about reincarnation, clearly stated.

The truth about the proven stories of past lives, traditional books of our country and China have also talked about it a lot. Just like stories about people borrowing their bodies to restore their souls, there are often stories, and official histories are often written about them. This caused quite a few disputes and lawsuits between the two families. Judges only pay attention to appearance, not soul, to avoid deceitful evils.

Layman Dinh Trong Co wrote Six Paths of Reincarnation Luc, which is a collection of traditional books, clearly talking about reincarnation, including several hundred cases, quoted in books, clearly stating the book's name and author. Those who do not believe in ghosts and spirits think that it is because religious believers want to advise people to do good deeds that they create such myths. But ancient histories were recorded according to the record judgments of the courts, not because religious people invented such myths. In the 4th year of the Republic of China (1915), in Shandong province, a farmer's son died and one day later came back to life. He did not know how to speak Chinese. He wrote down his name and said he was from Giao Chau Phu in Vietnam. Because someone died on the same day, he borrowed the body and brought it back to life. This story was personally investigated by Provincial Governor Thai Nho Giai and police chief Mai Quang Hy narrated this verdict. Shanghai newspapers also published this news.

From ancient times until now, records of stories like the above have been recorded by Confucian scholars. They are all well-educated people who do not believe in Buddhism. For example, in the Qing Dynasty, there were Vuong Ngu Duong, Vien Tu Tai, Ky Nhieu Lam, and Du Khuc Vien, all of whom were very learned people, not Buddhists, but the people who recorded the above events. Everyone took notes. From the Ming Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty, there was Thoi Chong Trinh, who made a law that if any scholar studied Buddhist texts, when he died, he could not be placed in the Temple of Confucius for worship. Therefore, the Confucian scholars of the Qing Dynasty slandered Buddhism, but in their writings, they recorded so many facts about demons, reincarnation, and retribution, it was enough to know that the truth was accurate. Their conscience does not allow them to destroy the recording of these truths. During the Song Dynasty, Confucian scholars liked to criticize the truth, but that was just their own subjective bias. If we talk about scholarship, like Au Duong Tu, revised the book New Tang Poetry. More than 2,000 sentences about the truth about ghosts, gods, and cause and effect recorded in the book Former Duong Thi have been erased, which is proof.Abandon objectivity, believe in subjectivity and then draw arbitrary conclusions. Therefore, for more than 100 years, academic decline and cultural depravity are the main reasons.

tieu_de: Proving Talking With Ghost Photography Van Dai
noi_dung:
Proof

Talking with the Devil

Nhich Van Dai

The text in the Premonition Luc by Female Artist Phuong Duc Hue recounts the situation of seeing ghosts and talking to ghosts. People today will think it's nonsense. In truth, we often hear rumors about this kind of thing, but what people in the past said was just a joke today. Now I would like to prove one thing: British La Ky Tuong Si, inventor of Radio and President of the London Scientific and Philosophical Society, during World War I, his son Nai Mong Dac participated in the campaign. One day his family had a happy event and many guests came. Before entering the banquet table, he saw his son standing on the stairs. Looking closely, he saw nothing more. He told this story to the audience.

The next day, we heard that his son had died. From there he communicated with his son's soul. He wrote a book to record this story, the name of the book is "Nai Mong Dac", also called "Life and Death". The content of the book is to use a scientific eye to discuss the immortal soul, translated by the Thuong Van An Thu Quan printing house as General Science. Spirituality has become a scientific research subject. But to this day, there are still many people who do not believe in the existence of a soul.

Doctor Ngu Dinh Phuong, a famous revolutionary, often told me that, when he was still working for the United States, he heard that Spiritualists could invite ghosts to talk. He didn't believe it either, so he invited that person to experiment. That person summoned the spirit of his friend, the landlady. Many years ago he lived in a house. When the ghost came, he invited an unfamiliar woman's ghost to come along. The doctor talked previously with the spirit of the old homeowner. When he was about to say goodbye, the Doctor took a flower and put it on his shirt button to give to the host's soul. The woman's ghost came and said: "Doctor, it's not fair, why don't you give me flowers?" The guest eating at the same table took a flower from his shirt and gave it to the doctor to give to the ghost's soul, and at that moment the ghost disappeared. The doctor said, the strangest thing was that the two flowers also disappeared at the same time.

Then ask that person to call Ly Hong Chuong's soul. Not long after, Ly Hong Chuong's soul appeared, dressed as when he was alive. The Doctor and Chuong talked about the Ma Quan treaty, because at that time the Doctor was Ly Hong Chuong's attache. The doctor said that Spiritualists cannot lie, and asked me: "Do you believe it or not? If I don't personally talk to ghosts, I won't believe it either." This story is similar to the book Ta Truyen, which records: "She suddenly met the Prince's soul twice, talking to each other. The situation was similar. That is enough to understand that, from ancient times until now, there are actually many records of this type of story, not something made up by religionists.

I transcribed Phuong Nu Si's text. So he wrote a letter to ask To Tran two lay people about Phuong Nu Si's background. After two months, I received a reply from Phuong Nu Si, and Mr. That's enough to know that Phuong Nu Si's opinions are very pure and her words and actions are truthful, so she recounts the story of her premonition. Truly has the nature of being sensitive to the Bodhisattva's epiphany, beautifying the phenomenon of the obscurity of the world. Continue for 20 days until it is completed thanks to Buddha's grace. I recount what I saw and heard of General Si La Ky and Doctor Ngu Dinh Phuong, to avoid readers' objections.

Lady Gu Gegang

The God of Memories

Professor Co Ge Gang at Yen Kinh University, is a scholar who firmly advocates no-demonism. Not only did he not believe in ghosts, gods, or the realm of nothingness, but even famous people in history such as Nghieu Tan Ha Vu have been recognized by everyone for thousands of years. He also had many things to attack, claiming that these characters did not exist. Before August 13, the Beijing Academic community had a very large organization called Nghi Co Group, Cat Cuong and Tien Huyen were loyal members of this group. After the enemy took over Beijing, Cat Cuong, his wife and children followed Chi1nh Phu to evacuate to the West. When arriving in Sichuan, stay in Beipei Town. In the fall of the 33rd Republic year (1944), his wife died in Bac Boi. He and his wife have a very deep relationship. After his wife died, he was very sad. Since then, he has not entered the room where the couple previously lived together. He locked the room door. He and his daughter, along with a worker and a relative who came to help, stayed in the outside rooms. Since then, strange noises and strange events have continuously occurred in his locked, vacant room. He and everyone in the house saw it with their own eyes and ears. This could not help but shake his policy of non-demonism to its core.What happened was like this. After finishing the shroud, Lady Cat kept hearing the sound of people walking around at 12 o'clock at night in the room. The sound of closet doors and drawers opening and closing. The sound of chairs moving, as if someone was cleaning and arranging, was quiet until the next morning. Cat Cuong and everyone in the house heard clearly. The next morning, when I opened the door, I saw that it was still the same, nothing unusual.

Just like that for three consecutive days. On Wednesday night, he was outside his room lighting a few candles. He learned this method from an ancient book, saying that if there is strong light, ghosts will not dare to come close. Who knew that, after midnight, something heavy seemed to fall from the roof. A moment later, I heard a sound like someone opening a wardrobe, pulling and closing drawers, like someone packing up things. From that day onwards, I never heard any more noise. Some people guessed that: The first three nights the ghost came in from outside the room, and on the fourth day, to avoid light, he entered the house from the roof. From now on, entering and exiting from the roof feels inconvenient, so I rarely go home anymore. There are also people who think: After four days of cleaning up, everything is done, so they won't come back.

One ​​night the soul returns according to Sichuan custom, sprinkle lime powder around and in the room, and close the door. The next day, open the door and see if there are any traces on the lime powder, then you can know if the ghost has returned or not. Cat Cuong then arranged according to local people's advice. The next morning, when I opened the door to the room, I saw many footprints of people wearing leather shoes. The flowers on the soles of the shoes were printed very clearly, indeed the flowers were on his wife's shoes, the shoes his wife had bought in Shanghai several years ago. These shoes were enshrined in the coffin when his wife died. This type of shoe is not available in Sichuan.

Our friends in Shanghai had heard this story, but I still didn't believe it. Last month, when Mr. Cat returned, we met and I immediately asked about this. He meticulously told me about it. I immediately asked him: "As for whether there are ghosts or not, what is your current opinion?" He replied: "I don't dare say there are no ghosts anymore, this is still unexplained by current science."

Editor

Giac Huu Tinh in July 35, 1946

tieu_de: A Letter from a Good Mandarin to His Son (The truth about ghost cause and effect)
noi_dung:
The Letter of a Good Official

To Children

(The truth about ghost cause and effect)

Cause and effect retribution is indeed not wrong, I am telling you the truth of one or two things I have seen with my own eyes, to let you know. A female student named Vuong Luong Tien, from Tan Diem village, Vinh Xuyen district, in the spring of the 29th year of the Republic of Korea (1940) because her father prevented her and Truong Hong Tung, a young man from the same village currently studying at Dat Lap school in Thanh Do, from falling in love. After shooting and killing Father, she put the gun back in its original place, then shouted loudly that her Father wiped the gun and accidentally fired the trigger, shooting him dead. After the local authorities came to investigate, they saw the pistol disassembled and scattered on the table. When they entered the examination room, they saw a rifle and the gun barrel was still hot. After two trials, investigators and officials considered and investigated, but did not dare to judge and decide. Until May of the 30th year of the Republic of China (1941), I gave orders to the Director of Vinh Xuyen, but an incompetent judge. This case was later examined by the Director of Tu Hanh, but he still did not dare to make a decision. I read the case file carefully, this house is divided into three rooms, the victim sat in the middle room cleaning his gun, looking forward, there was no window in the back. The next day, this case was brought to court. Based on the above reasons for questioning, although Ms. Vuong Tien has eloquent talent, it cannot be denied. I then gently advised: "Your father is a legend. You were deceived by Truong Hong Tung, I asked the authorities in Chengdu to arrest him. Currently he is keeping the status of Tai Dao. In his trunk, there are eighteen pictures of you. Now let me show you." After watching, Vuong Luong Tien shed tears. Ms. Tien's aunt, who was nearby, shouted loudly: "Vuong Luong Tien, what a retribution to meet a wise judge."

Because I'm busy with work and because I'm cautious about this case, I'm not in a hurry to condemn. That night I dreamed of trying this case, declaring before the court that "Vuong Luong Tien murdered his father, who was a direct blood relative, and was sentenced to indefinite imprisonment and deprivation of civil rights for life." At that time, a few people wearing ao dai said: "You did it right, you did it right, you did it very skillfully." A few days later, at Dieu Tran Giap's public office, a review specialist came to accept the position. Dieu in the 28th Republic of Korea passed very high, his ability was also quite good, and he accepted to research this case. After two interrogations, he told me: "The case of Vuong Luong Tien was unjust. I want the next trial to declare the verdict innocent" (Vuong often sewed children's clothes for Mrs. Dieu, and chatted with Mrs. Dieu every day). I told him my opinion, but he refused to listen. In order to maintain the independent spirit of the judge, I tell him to be careful.

Only one day before the trial, Dieu told me that Vuong Luong Tien had been unjustly accused. Her words were truly reasonable. Her father was not wrongly killed by the enemy. That afternoon, Dieu suddenly fell down from upstairs, loudly screaming that there was a ghost, jumping and running. Blood flowed continuously from his head. The doctor entered my room, and when he woke up, he said: "There are ghosts complaining and many strange faces with angry eyes glaring at me." For three consecutive days, day and night, she had to send someone to watch over him, and use rope to tie her arms and legs tightly. She was unable to move, but her mouth always shouted loudly that there was a ghost. On the fourth day, we had to tie him up tightly and hire someone to take him to the city hospital (At that time the court was in Lai To). Dieu regained consciousness gradually. After being treated for a while, he was still awake and unconscious. Because I have no one to help, I have to judge myself. When Vuong killed Father, he was not yet 18 years old, so I treated him lightly, as if he had dreamed a few days ago. After being sentenced, Dieu regained consciousness and was no longer screaming like the previous few days. On the night of the fifth day, I was alone. After reciting the Buddha's Sutras, I walked around the yard when I suddenly heard a noise coming from the room of the Great Vien.I looked in horror and saw that the door was still locked, so I called someone to open the lock and look in. I saw a hole in the cell wall the size of a bowl. It turned out that it was the sound of Vuong Luong Tien intending to escape from prison. After that, Vuong appealed the sentence and sent him to Dong Khanh. Three appeals were all rejected. Vuong crossed the wall again to escape, but was captured. The female prison guard locked Vuong's limbs until they bled. About a month later, because she could not stand the hardships, she died in prison.

But looking closely at this, it turns out that her father was also a bandit leader in the past, robbing and killing people. He earned money and went back to open a paper factory. His comrades often came to harass him, so her father bought a rifle for protection and kept it in the next room. Later, she bought another pistol. While her father was cleaning it, his daughter shot him in the back with a rifle and died (That's cause and effect). His wife recited Buddha's name every day. Seeing this, her daughter scolded her mother for being superstitious. It is said that the Mother has now become a monk.

The second thing is that Deng Bach Xuyen killed Deng Kham. I'm still young so I don't know this clearly. Kha Kham is a communist party member, active in our village. When the Red Army passed through, the Turks hated it. The cunning Bach Xuyen managed the Assembly Hall. The Kha Kham family is considered rare and often bullied. At that time, the Communist Party had power, and Kha Kham flourished. When the Nationalist Party official passed by, Bach Xuyen welcomed him at the Assembly Hall. When he was drunk, he told everyone: "Kham Kham is a communist, XX was harmed because of him. If I were young, I would risk my life with him, you guys wouldn't dare." When asked to instigate, Bach Xuyen added: "If you have the courage, you will take action, but you are on your own and have nothing to do with me." Everyone gathered and tied Kha Kham tightly, tied him to a large rock and then submerged him under a bamboo bush in the river. Bach Xuyen added: "To cut and weed, you must pull out the roots. Kha Kham's wife, Bao Co, is currently pregnant, afraid she will take revenge in the future." Everyone rushed to Kha Kham's house, but by then Bao Co had already fled, reaching the shore of Bao Coc Lam to give birth to a child, leaving the child behind and running for his life. After the child was bitten to death by a dog.Bao Co ran to Vu Xuong to plead with Mr. Thach Anh working in Bo Kien Thiet to clear his name, and Thach Anh kept him to help with housework. At that time, your mother and I went to Hoang Ni Cuong in Nanjing. More than a month later, I went to Wuchang to meet Thach Anh. Bao Co cried and said: "Please take revenge for my husband." I took Bao Co to Duong Tan Hoi Quan and promised to find a way to help. On the third day, more than ten people who were forced by Bach Xuyen came, and more than ten people who were instigated by Bach Xuyen also came, all of whom told the story. I thought, about 2 hours later, I told the ten people who opposed Bach Xuyen to go home, three people stayed. Those who were instigated by Bach Xuyen also returned. I told them, this is a murder case. You heard Bach Xuyen incite you to do something stupid. If you know the crime, you must gather some money and bring it to me to settle." Everyone accepted. We let them go home temporarily.

That night, I taught them the remaining three people's plan and said: "An unfortunate incident happened in our village. If it is not handled skillfully, there will be no face left to see the Ancestors' faces. If the three of you follow my advice, the incident will be over." All three people agreed to listen to the order. I said: "The three of you should go home, but you can't go back to your own house. Go and stay with someone you know in a neighboring village. Wait until the X day of the X month at the Quan Quan Quan and drink wine. Then the three of you should rush in and shout loudly to arrest the enemy, but only arrest Bach Xuyen alone, without involving the others. I assure you everything will go smoothly."

I prepared a copy of the Affairs Order for them. The content was to escort prisoner Dang Bach Xuyen to Wuchang for interrogation. If there was a police search on the way, there would be identification. I carefully instructed these three people, commanded by Vinh Trac, to return to Tu Khau. That night, no one dared to stop Bach Xuyen at the drinking party at Hoi Quan. When Vinh Trac led Bach Xuyen out of the Assembly Hall door, he heard Bach Xuyen shout loudly: "Kham Kham is here! It won't work, I will die." Trac asked: "Where is Kha Kham?" Bach Xuyen replied: "That's right in front. I was wrong, Kha Kham. I know I was wrong. I will open a Taoist Temple to invite the Master to save you, please forgive me. My mother is over 70 years old this year, very pitiful."

Vinh Trac saw this and knew that everything was going well, so he ordered him not to speak and obediently set off on his way. Vu Xuong agreed to negotiate, getting off the bus from the station, Bao Co grabbed Bach Xuyen to complain, until he was immediately interrogated and detained by the ministry commander. Bach Xuyen is Tu Thu Nong's nephew. Thu Nong is a classmate of many Dang people, and is also a close acquaintance. When he arrived at Wuchang, he found me and told me that his mother only had one child. “Death sentences can be waived, but they must be imprisoned for five years or more, fifteen years or less.” I won't say any more. As a result, he was sentenced to seven years in prison. I used the money from the accomplices to set up a funeral pyre and a stele for Kha Kham. Two years later, his wife Bao Co remarried a man named Tran. There is a little cause and effect involved in this. Kha Kham's wife was unfilial to her mother-in-law and also committed suicide because of Kha Kham's unfilial piety. As for Kha Kham, it was also because of unfilial piety and Bao Co's instigation, Kha Kham. After three years, Bao Co married another man, a man named Tran, who was killed by rebels.While Bach Xuyen was in prison, I asked someone to come and ask for help. I said: "You only need to recite the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Sutra in prison, and one day you will escape." At that time, I didn't really know Buddhism. When I saw someone coming to ask, I said it off-handedly, the purpose was to encourage him. As a result, Bach Xuyen was imprisoned for a few years, then was released and returned home. After giving birth to a son, he died. As for his son, he doesn't know if he's still alive or not. Until now, there has been no news.

I heard your mother say that last night I dreamed that Kha Kham came to thank me. My mother said he should go thank Mantra Binh Trong. He replied: "He is prosperous, I don't dare to meet him", then bowed long and disappeared. Our people have seen many truths about retribution, and now we have nominated the two cases of Vuong Luong Tien and Dang Kham to clarify the authenticity of the law of cause and effect.

Practicing the Ksitigarbha Sutra

(Associate Priest of the Method)

Nhich Van Dai

Some people say that this Atomic Age is still negative, let alone Buddhism? Does modern materialism still talk about idealistic Buddhism? My answer is: the effect of atomic energy can turn a city into nothing, can it be said to be positive? Buddhism is a solid fortress, protecting humanity's safety and peace, which can be guaranteed in a society where many people have political views, sympathy, respect, disdain, and avoid doing evil things such as committing crimes, arguing, and killing each other. Therefore, the invisible Dharma eliminates all disasters and damages. Isn't that true positivity?

Buddhism is about idealism. The most important thing is to clear thoughts, disregard ego, and benefit humanity and sentient beings. Deploying hundreds of thousands of years of history. Those who are famous for their emphasis on Buddhism, or are in the government, often see miserable and pitiful people and give alms, that is formless, that is true great compassion, that is the realm of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, that is the genuine Mahayana sect. Buddhism basically does not discriminate between big and small, it depends on everyone's mind. It's the same story of giving alms, some people give thousands of gold, but the merit is small, some people give one coin, but the merit is great. There was a young girl who, because of her Mother, made a great vow to become a Bodhisattva and attain enlightenment. Therefore, anyone can learn Mahayana Buddhism, as long as they have the heart to benefit others, are truly compassionate, and are not contaminated at all, that is, Mahayana Buddhism. All of this is very clearly taught in the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Therefore, these small merits have a very miraculous effect, especially in the age of the end of dharma, when karma is very heavy, and sentient beings have less suffering and are at peace. In this era, the vast majority of people do not believe in ghosts and gods, nor do they believe in cause and effect retribution.I also do not dare to dissuade, if there are still people who have good roots and can still develop the mind to practice according to the Sutras, they will definitely be inspired and will receive many benefits.

The reason I collect Special Issue books that have published recent premonitions is to prove it. I hope readers who read this article should not take it lightly. That is my earnest request.

Practice Method

(Instructions for beginners)

- Worship with pictures, frame a glass cage with a Bodhisattva image to worship. If the house is narrow and does not have a reception room, then you can hang the picture by the window in the bedroom, or in a quiet place. Early in the evening, light a stick of incense and worship.

- People who can recite sutras can recite one sutra every day, recite the entire sutra every three days, or recite the entire sutra every day, depending on each person's time. If you have anything to ask for, make a vow to read as many books as you can, make your own decisions, and make your vows clearly before the Bodhisattva.

- People who don't know how to read the sutras just need to recite Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's seven-word holy name a thousand times a day. If time does not allow, then reciting one or two hundred times is fine, but it must be respectful, at least there is a response. But if you don't truly take refuge and just want to call it a try, then it's probably difficult to have any response.

- Although it is not necessary to practice vegetarianism, if you want to gain real benefits, you should observe six days of fasting each month (On the 8th, 14th, 15th, 22nd, 29th or 30th and 1st day of the lunar calendar), or ten days (On the 1st, 8th, 14th, 15th, 18th, 23rd, 24th, 28th, 29th and 30th) of the lunar calendar. lack. If you cannot control yourself when serving external affairs, it is difficult to do it, but if you can do it, you should try to do it and advise everyone in the house to work together and cooperate on the set days to fast, the most important day is not to kill.

- Everyday, recite Buddha's name or Guanyin's holy name. In addition, it is also okay to recite and read the Ksitigarbha Sutra or recite the Holy Name.

- Ordinary people only know how to pray to avoid disasters and receive blessings, that is allowed by the Buddhadharma. They should know that grace will come true, create their own work to eliminate disasters and receive blessings, so every day after reciting the sutra, dedicate and sincerely pray to the Bodhisattva for blessings to be able to develop true wisdom and knowledge, develop Bodhi mind, open compassion, pray often, these four things are the main way to pray to avoid disasters and receive blessings. I roughly explain what it means to open the eyes of wisdom. People only see the mistakes and sins of others, but do not see the mistakes they have made. This is just the ignorance of the boundary view. On the contrary, only seeing your own mistakes without seeing the mistakes of others is expanding your wisdom.

People always think about their own selfish interests, only seeking pleasure, thinking that is wisdom, not knowing that is ignorance. On the contrary, taking advantage of one's own personal interests and desires, benefiting others, thinking that it is beneficial for oneself is opening the eyes of wisdom. That is the development of Bodhi mind. Bodhi mind means enlightenment. People in the world perceive disaster as blessing, harm as benefit, that is only the immediate future, not seen in the future. That is delusion, realizing that the delusion has passed is enlightenment. Enlightenment means Buddha.

In addition, it is not Buddhism, it is just a person with right knowledge, full of faith in the truth of cause and effect, not allowed to be swayed by conventional and wrong views, and has compassion for others. This is the basis of all merit. In general, all people who have compassion for others are people with great wisdom. People with fragile virtues will inevitably lack sympathy. We only pray for blessings. If we treat people without compassion and love, it goes against Buddhism. Our requests are difficult to satisfy. If you can always pray for the Bodhisattva's blessing on the four things mentioned above, and always remember them in your heart, that is a double-cultivated hidden blessing, in accordance with your heart, will naturally respond very quickly, and your wish will be fulfilled. The two words "Namo" are translated as taking refuge, or taking refuge. When reciting the Buddha's name and claiming the Bodhisattva title, you need to keep in your heart the Bodhisattva destiny, then in your mind, sincerity will naturally come. Buddhas and Bodhisattvas use the Dharma realm to make their bodies. The Dharma Realm has no space or time (Including the past, present and future). It is a unified noun.Confessing the title of Buddha or Bodhisattva means the mind is in harmony with the entire dharma realm. Therefore, there is a very strong induction of supreme power. The meaning is that the Buddha Dharma attains fruition, that is, it escapes the consciousness in this small body, but seals the Dharma realm in the large body. In the Diamond Sutra it is said: "What Buddha said is not the body, it is the big body." That means it is not the body of consciousness, not this mortal body, that can become a great body. Angels and demons are just bodies of consciousness, not yet out of the three realms (desire world, form world and formless world) compared to the realm of Buddha and Bodhisattva, which is very different.

Appendix

Recording the reading of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Prayer of the Luc Inspiration Sutra

Ly Van Khai

Disciple Tue Teng (my Dharma name), from the day he made up his mind to recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Prayer Sutra and claimed the Holy Name until now, there have been six points of inspiration that he has not dared to express. Recently, an old layman in Tainan, Ta Tru Tran, had the heart to reprint the book Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Premonitions, and a layman Tran A Nam sent a letter to advise him to write down and print the 6 premonitions to benefit people. I, Van Khai, knew that my karma was heavy, my wisdom was poor, my education was rudimentary, and my writing was poor, so I did not dare to accept the invitation. Layman De Trieu sent a letter to urge him again. Because of his feelings, he could not escape, so now he had to write a few preliminary notes as follows:

In the 7th month of the 44th year of the Republic of China (1955), on the 30th day of the lunar calendar, during the break of dawn I dreamed of my Mother, praying for salvation. That morning, I immediately went to Thien Dao Temple in Taipei, participated in the Ksitigarbha Dharma Conference, recited the Holy Name and read the Sutra with everyone. After the Dharma assembly was completed, I told my friend about the dream. That friend told me: "If we want to pray for our parents, we need to make a vow to read and recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Vow Sutra." I immediately went to the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. I bowed and vowed: "From today onwards, I will dedicate myself to reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and claiming the Holy Name. In one month, read all 24 Sutras, chant the Holy Name ten thousand times, and use this merit to pray for my Mother's salvation." Up to now, reciting the Sutra and pronouncing the Holy Name has been completed. I don't understand whether my Mother has been saved or not. Up to now, there has been no response.Knowing that the karma of my previous life and this life is very heavy, if I do not make a great vow, it is impossible, so for the second time I made a great vow: "From the 9th month of the 44th Republic year of the lunar calendar on the 1st day onwards, to the 45th year of the Republic of China, the 30th day of the 7th lunar month, I renew my vow to read 500 volumes of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Prayer Sutra, recite the Holy Name 1,000 times a day, and practice good deeds. like midwifery and releasing animals." From then on, I remember to do this every day and don't dare to be late. In the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Vow Sutra, the Tathagata Praise Sutra chapter states: "Universally, a person who uses divine power, if a relative comes before the statues of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, wholeheartedly recites this Sutra himself or invites others to read it three or seven times. If a relative is in an evil path, after reading it regardless of the number of times, he will be liberated." I saw the 12th chapter, the Kien Van Loi Ich chapter, saying: "Again, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva! If there are good men or good women in the next life who want to pray for hundreds of thousands of millions of times in the present or the future, hundreds of thousands of millions of times of work, they should take refuge, worship and worship the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva." At that time, all prayers will be fulfilled.After reading these two chapters, my heart ached, tears streaming down my face, repenting that I learned Buddhism too late, read the Sutras too late. In my eternal past life, my parents and six relatives belonged to the six paths of rotation and endured boundless suffering. I then made a great vow for the third time:

The first thing: "Disciple Tue Dang, respectfully read the Sutra and recite the Holy Name, praying to Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva Great Compassion Great Wisdom Great Wisdom Great Power, to save your parents from the previous life forever, to soon escape the cycle of suffering, in this life your parents will soon be born in the Pure Land."

The second thing: "Praying for Bodhisattva Mahasattva's blessings to bless them, I would like to learn the words and actions of the Bodhisattva, with a heart of compassion to eliminate all negative karma in past and present lives, increase wisdom, everything will be auspicious, and pray for the two children in the future to have favorable conditions."

From the day of the vow, after three or four months, all the premonitions given by the Great Master appeared one after another. The first thing is that I have a skin disease, even in my old age it still hasn't gone away, it's itchy and uncomfortable, no medicine can cure it. Since reading the Sutra, I have gradually recovered. The second thing is that my daughter's name is Tuong. After stopping trading in Hong Kong, her daughter-in-law was always sick so she insisted on going to Taiwan to find a job. Then she received an immigration permit, and while preparing to depart, there was a businessman in Hong Kong who was lacking workers, so she was recruited to work. The daughter-in-law's illness was also completely cured. The third thing is that my other child's name is Trach, he works at a company in Hong Kong. He graduated from an American university with a degree in air conditioning and just received his degree. While another company wanted to hire an air conditioning officer, my son applied for the job. When I took the exam, I was hired. The director said: "There are more than 200 candidates, only you are qualified."

If that's not having the Great Master's blessing, then what is? My son Trach was not good at accounting, so the director hired an accountant to accompany him for 3 months and sent him to Liu Cau Company to serve him. If that is not the Great Master's blessing, what is it? My son thought to himself that he felt grateful for the Great Master's grace and did not know how to repay him, so he vowed to read Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Vow every day for the rest of his life without stopping. On October 17, 1956, when I read all 500 sets of the Prayer Sutra, I thought to myself that in just one day, both of my children got new jobs. Wasn't that a premonition given by the Great Master? The fourth thing is that my daughter-in-law graduated from Fudan University in Shanghai, was idle at home, and was looking for a job, so she voluntarily read the Sutra. There is a company in Hong Kong that wants to hire a secretary. At that time, my son had a job. Although my daughter-in-law wants to find a job, she is not in a hurry. Because she has just recovered from her illness, she came to see for relief. A company employee handed out a job application. My daughter-in-law received the application and simply wrote it. Out of more than 70 candidates, my daughter-in-law was accepted. Isn't that the Great Master's blessing? There's no doubt about it anymore.

The fifth thing is 6 pm on January 30, 1956 (1956). Suddenly, while chanting, I suddenly thought: Has my mother been liberated? I knelt in front of the altar of the Great Master's statue and prayed: "Disciple Tue Dang, please advise Bodhisattva, has your mother been reborn in the Pure Land?" According to the Sutra's instructions, read this Sutra with your own mind, or invite others to read it three or seven times. If you are a relative in the evil path, after reading it a few times, you will be liberated. The disciple has read all 131 volumes of the Sutra, but has not received any favor from the Great Master, so he is very confused.

Pray until Tuesday (the 2nd day of the month

3), at 5 a.m., I was resting in bed when I suddenly heard my mother calling my nickname: "Come here, come here quickly." I heard Mother's voice calling and I was very happy, saying loudly: "Mom, you're back!" At that time, my heart was extremely happy, I quickly stood up and went out, following the direction of my mother's call, I discovered a strip of land with very beautiful scenery, the scene was as beautiful as Di Hoa Vien. The path was as flat as crystal, bright as a mirror, clearly illuminating a person dressed as a beautiful palace maid, standing and smiling. I saw clearly who it was, thinking it must be my mother, so I quickly walked closer to pay my respects. When I got closer, all the beautiful scenery disappeared. Thinking that perhaps my mother had given birth to Thien, I was so happy that I woke up and it turned out to be a dream. Even though it was just a dream, it was also the Great Sage's compassion that informed the dream. I am extremely grateful. The next day I met a Dharma Master and told him everything that happened in the dream. The Dharma Master said: "There is no doubt about it anymore", His mother had already been born in Heaven, had gone to the Pure Land. The person standing next to him is the Bodhisattva appearing."

The sixth thing is that my family is now old, has no grandchildren, and is very sad inside. I think the Great Master often had a premonition of giving grace to people, so he made a fourth vow: "Disciple Tue Dang, please ask the Bodhisattva to give grace to you guys." He made this vow in March of the 45th year of the Republic of China (1956). In July of that year, he received news that Tuong sent a letter to Trach informing him that his sister-in-law was pregnant. At the end of the pregnancy, she gave birth to a son named Bao Anh. I was so happy when I heard this news that I cried twice. If anyone asks why are you crying? I answered that I am always blessed by Bodhisattva, that grace is endless. I wondered what merit I had to repay this kindness, so I was both happy and ashamed, so I couldn't hold back my tears. Van Khai repays this profound grace, the only way is to wholeheartedly surrender his life and respectfully worship and propagate the Buddha Dharma, to abstain from killing and liberating animals, to advise fellow practitioners and fellow believers, to read the Ksitigarbha Sutra and recite the Holy Name, to pray for eternal Parents to soon escape the suffering of reincarnation, and to pray for present Parents, vowing to practice Pure Karma, to be born in the Pure Land, and to attain Buddhahood.

Now Van Khai reads the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Vow Sutra and recites the holy name, describing the 6 premonitions, all spoken from the heart, not daring to say anything wrong. I would like to add that starting from July 30, year 44 (1955) to October 28, Republic year 46 (1957), reading Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Prayer Sutra totaled 1517 volumes, chanting the Holy Name without interruption. From then on, continue reading the Sutras and chanting the Holy Names indefinitely. All fellow practitioners and fellow believers, please believe in my words, so soon develop your mind to read the scripture and chant the holy names. You will gain boundless merit and repay your parents' gratitude in this life and in the lives to come.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Inspiration Notes

Do Due Bon

In the spring of the 45th year of the Republic of China (1956), layman Ly Van Khai advised me to read the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Starting from the third week of the third lunar month, every morning I read one set of the Ksitigarbha Sutra and recited the holy name several hundred times. I know that my karma is very heavy, my blessings are poor, and my wisdom is poor. Every time you read the Sutra, you think nonsense and do not recite Buddha's name single-mindedly. But over the past two years, I have often dreamed about the souls of my relatives and friends. Could it be that the Bodhisattva saved them, so they escaped suffering and were happy? Nine-tenths of the unsatisfactory events in human life are due to the fact that sentient beings have gone through countless lifetimes, creating all negative karma, so the karmic force is influenced, creating all realms of affliction.

From the day I read the Sutra until now, the undesirable events have gradually decreased. In the situation of the world, some people get what they want, many people encounter adversity and manifest themselves. Sometimes, because of causes and conditions, they give rise to the reflection of reason without self-nature, anger gradually decreases, and the power of reciting the Sutra is weak, without any special clarity. But personally, I have received the blessing of welfare and have a light heart. This proves that the Bodhisattva's generous compassion, helping sentient beings is very real, without any shortcomings.

Dear Thich Ton preached the Dharma in the Dao Loi Heaven for Mother's sake, triggering the devotion of Ksitigarbha Sutra. The main truth in the Sutra is that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva vows every action to save Mother. Those who read this Sutra must first of all respect their parents and consider them as living Buddhas.
