Great Vow of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Incarnation

My residence is at 16 Lam Gia Trang Lan Vien in Nanjing. There are bamboo fences on all four sides, and two doors in the front and back. One morning in July of the 24th year of the Republic of China (1935), the front and back doors had not yet been opened when suddenly an old monk flew in, wearing a Pi Lo hat and wearing a navy blue shirt. On his chest, he wore more than ten long rosary beads that reached to the ground. The two rosary beads on the sleeves also reached to the ground, looking very dignified, the rosary was bright. I asked: “Where did Old Master come from?” The old monk replied: "Amitābha Buddha. I come from Anhui Nine Hoa Mountains." I immediately asked: "The door is not open yet, how can Master come in?" The old monk replied: "I have magical powers, I can go anywhere", then showed me a thick book with the eight-word title Cuu Hoa Son Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, the cover is plated with gold letters, three words Cuu Hoa Son are written horizontally, and the other five words are written vertically, the four sides are also gold, very shiny.

The old monk clasped his hands and said: "I have come to transform fate." I said: "If that's the case, I'll call it a little check writing." Old Monk said: "I don't take money. I came today to try to find you and tell you a few stories." I asked: "Master, how did you recognize me?" The old monk replied: "I have magical powers so I have known you for a long time." I noticed the blue hat of the very special old monk. The old monk immediately said: "That is an ancient hat. This year I am over 100 years old." I then pulled out a chair and invited him to sit. He refused to sit. I poured him some water. He also refused to drink, and only said: "Amitābha Buddha! You are a person with good roots and have a relationship with Buddha. Only after you were 40 years old did you see the need to study Buddhism. Only then did you understand what I said." I asked: "How does Master know about my life?" The old monk replied: "I know everything in your heart. I also know everything about your past life. I also know about your three previous lives. I will tell you. I hope that in the future you will cultivate well and be better than your previous life. In any case, you will have better achievements. I see that you are currently skeptical. I advise you not to doubt, because I have supernatural powers so I can understand."

At that time, I saw that the old monk's appearance was very dignified. Suddenly came here and talked about many things, and kept saying that he had magical powers. I didn't understand what magical powers were, I really had doubts in my heart, I was still thinking, everything was understood by old man Tang. I really don't know what Buddha is. My mother and mother-in-law both believe in Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, so I also believe in Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. The old monk talked about what Buddha is and what Bodhisattva is. There are many holy names of Buddha and Bodhisattva. After the age of 40, she naturally understood everything. It seemed to me that she was still skeptical and didn't really believe it. Now I tell you the truth. For example, he is Chau Bang Dao, a director of education at the Ministry of Education. Whatever his appearance and personality, I told her and she believed immediately." I asked: "Master, how did you know him?" Old Monk said: "I told you that I have magical powers, I want to see him anytime." Ton and Hua, two workers standing next to him, said: "He has a lot of friends, and many rumors, who doesn't know!" Old Monk said: "If that's the case, then children probably won't have many friends or gossip, so I'll talk about children.Her fourth child's name is Xuan De, who lives next door, I don't need to say, the eldest child is Xuan Canh, the second child is Xuan Phuc, the third child is Xuan Quy, they all go to Primary School in Lien Hoa Kieu, their appearance and character are needless to say, isn't that right? Now you can believe it. She is a kind, dutiful mother, filial to her parents and parents-in-law. In her previous life, Binh had a special relationship with her mother-in-law, so she was very filial to her. For humanity, filial piety is very important, being filial to your parents is a very precious thing in life.

At that time, my fifth child named Xuan Duong was still pregnant. The birth specialist saw that my belly was too big, thought there was a problem, so they refused to take charge of helping with the birth. I was very worried and felt extremely guilty. Old Monk said: "Currently you are pregnant with a boy, your bones are big so your belly is big, don't worry, there is no danger at all, on the 9th day of the 8th month, Dragon time, the baby was born, giving birth was very easy, the child did not cry at all, that's his temperament" and also said: "You gave birth to five sons and then a daughter. Actually, you were supposed to have five sons and two daughters. But you were not good at cultivating well so you only had one daughter. When the daughter was born, When you are born, you will be in trouble, but I often come to help you. Don't worry, there is no danger to your life. But one thing is that you must make a vow to worship the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas at the altar on Cuu Hoa Mountain. If you don't say anything, I ask you if you can offer 100 kilos of lamp oil. If possible, it will ensure that the whole family is safe, and there will be no danger at all when giving birth to your daughter.Is it possible to offer 20?” I said: "Maybe". The old monk did not write it down in his handbook, just wrote on a piece of paper "Chau Duong Tue Khanh offered 20 kg of lamp oil", then asked me to light three incense sticks and follow him to the southwest behind the garden to perform the ceremony. The old monk burned the paper and said: "The Nine Flowers Mountain already knows about this." I saw that old monk walking back and forth with his feet as light as flying without a sound. Inside I felt strange, but I didn't understand why? I asked, “How does Master know my last name?” He replied: "I have said many times that I have magical powers." I took the money and gave it to him. He did not accept it, saying: "Your offering of oil is enough. If you bring the oil yourself, I will personally greet you." If you send someone to bring it, I won't come out again. You can send this person (pointing to someone with the last name Ton, saying: "This person is from Anhui district". That person will know to enter this Palace" (then write Dien's name on the piece of paper. Unfortunately, during the resistance war, the family moved many times, so this piece of paper was lost).

Hua Thi pouted and said: "Are you saying you don't take money, even though it's not money?" Old Monk said: "What do you know? What was your past life? It's very pitiful, I don't want to say. Your boss is a very rare good person, so I came here to talk to her. Don't say too much. It's almost afternoon, my husband is about to go home from work. He has a hot temper, he will think of me as a Venerable monk, a Venerable who needs money, and scolds me and you no matter what. Don't be angry, I'm not angry either. He is a kind-hearted person. He was angry for a while but it was okay. Last year, when he was in Shanghai, someone came and pretended to be your friend and stole some money from you. Did you really scold you? That money was owed to that person in your previous life. It's a good thing to pay that person now. You shouldn't be upset and cry anymore." (Because of this, I was very upset and cried).

When my husband was in Nanjing, he often went to the China Society Institute to visit Master. He was an old layman Chau Thieu Do. He spent money to engrave Sutras, and asked Great Master Au Duong Canh Nghi Hoang to carve a stele in front of Mother's grave. In the stele, "Rotating three thousand is just a light effort. Being grateful to our Parents is a great merit. We engrave the stele to worship Mother, hoping to reach the Pure Land soon." However, he had never heard the sutras recited, did not understand the Buddha's teachings, and did not understand the meaning of the Sangha. At that time, because of the influence of the event of eliminating superstitious concepts, his thoughts were contradictory. Because that year I was deceived by people, he thought I was stupid or deceived, and when I went home I didn't find out the details, so he got angry and scolded me for not being obedient and arbitrarily donating money. Most of you people borrowed the Venerable's name and used predestined relationships to ask for money for personal gain.

The old monk smiled and said: "I know you will be angry. Don't scold me and don't curse your wife. In your previous life you cultivated well, in this life you have a good wife, in the future you will have to ask your wife to save you and help you. Amitābha Buddha: Amitābha Buddha."

Hua Thi's employee sent old Tang out the door. When he came back, he told me that he didn't know why he was nowhere to be seen when he left the door, and didn't understand what was going on? I was very sad about this because I didn't understand why, the old monk's words did not dare to tell my husband. But the monk's clothes, rosary, voice, smile, and gestures are all deeply imprinted in my brain.

Dragon hour on August 9 of that year, my fifth child was indeed born. When he was born, he was very quiet, fell asleep without a single cry. Mother and child are both safe. On January 26, when I gave birth to my child Xuan Ban, I had abdominal inflammation, the condition was serious, it took more than a month of treatment to recover, and the danger turned into safety. Everything that happened was completely consistent with what the old monk said the other day.

The resistance was fierce, my family left Nanjing and migrated back to the countryside. In January of the 27th Republic Year (1938), my husband was ordered to take the position of principal of the Third National High School. The whole family moved from Thuy Kim to Dong Nhan Gui Chau. In the spring of his 30th year (1941), my husband transferred to Chongqing to hold the position of Advisor to the Examination Institute, and my mother and I remained in Tongren Guizhou. I often think about my mother-in-law, who passed away more than ten years ago, and I miss her very much. Every time I think about it, tears flow. I had just turned 40 years old that September, and often thought about how to repay the favor. Some people say that if you want to repay your mother-in-law, you must worship Buddha and read the Bo blood sutra. A Taoist woman came and said she would teach me to read the sutra, but I had to bow to the woman as Teacher. For some reason, I felt unsatisfied, so I delayed many times and refused to go to her house.

March 31 (1944), at night I dreamed of two monks wearing robes, with shoulder-length ears, one wearing a blue shirt, entering the door and calling my name and saying: "Is the ancient rosary of the Han Dynasty, made of Arhat jade, still available?" (This rosary was given to my husband when he was in Ha Nam Sung Son in Trung Nhac Temple by the old monk). Another monk said: "Don't worry so quickly, I will introduce you later." Introduce? I don't know what you mean by introduction, but I said it politely, asking Master to pay attention.

On June 19, at the Dong Nhac temple in Dong Nhan, there was a Quan Am Hoi, suddenly someone loudly said three or four times: "Take refuge in the Three Jewels", "Take refuge in the Three Jewels" three or four times like that. Everyone hears this saying, but doesn't know who said it, and doesn't understand the meaning of Taking Refuge in the Three Jewels, they just hear the sound. After I went to ask Master Khoan Ngan for advice, I learned a little about that saying. I then asked to take refuge, but he did not agree and said: "During the resistance war, I only worried about running around, what should I take refuge in? Later, I will go to Pho Da Son to take refuge." I begged and begged. He reluctantly accepted, and said: "I really don't want you to take refuge, but suddenly there was a voice in space, I'm afraid the Bodhisattva is calling you to take refuge", and then performed a simple ritual. So I started taking refuge in the Three Jewels, and after the age of 40, I will believe in Buddha and study Buddhism. That was the experience of the old Master's words from many years ago that I had forgotten, but now I remember.

After taking refuge, Master Khoan Ngan taught me to read the Great Compassion Mantra. I asked him to teach me how to read the Diamond Sutra, but he refused and said: "You don't understand, why read?" One night I dreamed that an old Venerable taught me to read the Amitabha Sutra, and after reading it, I saw a boat flying by in the air. I asked in fear: "Why can a boat fly?" The Venerable said: "It is not an easy-to-see object." When I turned back, the boat and the Venerable had also disappeared, with the Amitabha Sutra still in my hand. When I woke up, even the Amitabha Sutra in my hand was no longer there. I thought carefully about the appearance and aura of this old Venerable and found many similarities with the Master I met in Nanjing. From then on, I often thought of the Venerable from many years ago.

The next morning, Master Khoan Ngan came and said: "On the stairs downstairs, I heard you reading Amitabha Sutra." I recounted the story of that night dreaming about reading Amitabha Sutra. I would like to ask what is Amitabha Sutra? Luckily, he briefly explained it to me more or less. That afternoon, when he put the books out to dry, my son saw a book of Buddhist scriptures previously printed by Mr. Truong Mac Quan (those books he did not bring with him when he was in Nanjing. I don't know why there was a book of Sutras mixed in with the pile of books. That's probably a special thing). Diamond Sutra, Amitabha Sutra, Infinite Life Sutra, Heart Sutra, Great Compassion Mantra, etc., are all included. I was so happy, from then on I devoted myself to chanting Sutras and mantras, day and night non-stop, forgetting all my fatigue.

During the resistance war, my husband also made a point of chanting Ma Loi Chi Thien Sutra. The old layman Chau Thieu Do also sent a letter telling him to read the Amitabha Sutra and confess the Holy name of Guan Yin. In Dong Khanh, Mr. Dai Quy Dao was also inspired, his faith in Buddha became more and more solid, and he chose many Sutras to send to Dong Nhan for me. When he was in Jiangxi in charge of education, there was a Buddha Hall in my house, and he often came with us to worship Buddha. After arriving in Taiwan, he was introduced by the old layman Long Kien Hanh, took refuge with the Venerable Nam Hoa Hu Van, and was also an old disciple who often followed Ly Tuyet Lu, listening to the Sutras and learning Buddhism very well. That was roughly his reason for studying Buddhism.

July 42 (1953) was the Holy Birthday of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Layperson Tuyet Lu gave my family about ten statues of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. I looked at the picture of the Bodhisattva and saw that his clothes and rosary looked exactly like the 100-year-old monk from Nine Hoa Son who came to my house in Nanjing 24 years ago. The difference is that the statue's appearance is a bit younger, and in its hand is a tin Tich Truong. I thought back to his words and everything that happened proved to be true. I told my family in detail. After hearing this, my wife was shocked and said: "There are such rare relics, of course they are the reincarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Why didn't you tell me about it sooner? I have been guilty until now. Because you made the Bodhisattva vow, I also know that only with concentration, single-mindedness and virtue, I follow and practice together. Isn't that you who saved me and helped me? Therefore, I respectfully bow to the Buddha and repent wholeheartedly."

In December, Taichung Bao Thien Tu invited Bach Thanh Dharma Master to lecture on "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Vow Sutra". The Dharma Master is the person who received The Phat at Cuu Hoa Son. When preaching the Sutra, we often talk about the story of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. The Sutras also talk about the path of worship, such as building stupas, carving images, and offering lamp oil. I thought about the past stories, according to the original report, asked if there was a Buddhist monk over 100 years old on Cuu Hoa Mountain? The Dharma Master replied: "I have been in Cuu Hoa Son for many years, and have never heard or seen any Venerable who can prove the story of 18 years ago, that his incarnation was over 100 years old." That must have been Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's incarnation. He held a thick book for her to see and saw those golden words but refused to open it for her to write. He walked away and then disappeared again. This is a kind of manifestation that is difficult to describe. Ksitigarbha often incarnates here and there at Holy Relics. Many people who live near Cuu Hoa Son receive this grace.

After asking once, it can be said that there is no doubt that the other champion can be compared. The eyes of ordinary people cannot recognize Saints, nor can they distinguish between Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. Therefore, ordinary people lose an opportunity that is difficult to encounter in human life, so they do not ask much about cause and effect, do not ask for advice, and may violate the dignity of the Gods and Bodhisattvas, causing sins. So it's too late to repent, and it's difficult to redeem for a hundred generations.

My family and I respectfully bowed before the altar of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva at Bao Thien Temple, offered 20 kilos of clear oil, to show our sincere wishes, sincerely pray, repent for what we have done, and dedicate ourselves to the Dharma world, as well as heaven and earth. Repent for sins from the past until now, hoping to reduce karma and move towards the Dharma world.

It's been almost a year since last year's repentance and worship to the Buddha. Briefly recalling the gist of the story, I honestly tell you fellow practitioners, along with citing the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Vow Sutra, in the "Seeing and Hearing the Benefits" chapter of the World-Honored One, he said: "I see Ksitigarbha's majestic divine power, countless eons of time it is difficult to explain, seeing, hearing and worshiping in one thought, benefits the world immeasurably." If you want to cultivate unsurpassed Bodhi and develop the mind of Great Compassion, you should first worship the Buddha's Statue. All wishes will be quickly achieved, and no karma will come near.

The 43rd year of the Republic of China (1954), November 9.

Question: What day is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy birthday?

Answer: July 30 falls on the calendar.

Question: What is the basis?

Answer: In the 4th year of Yonghui in the Tang Dynasty, in the East there was the Silla country (that is, the current state of Goryeo). After becoming a monk, Crown Prince Kim Kieu Giac used a boat to go to China, to the Jiu Zhishan mountain on the Jiuhua Mountain in Anhui province, practicing for 75 years. During the reign of Tang Huyen Tong, he attained enlightenment in the 16th year on July 30, and then entered samadhi for 20 years. On July 30, the 2nd year of Duong Chinh Duc, the Tang Dynasty declared the saint to erect a stupa, so Ksitigarbha's birthday is that day.

Question: Is Cuu Hoa Son the Bodhisattva's ashram?

Answer: Yes, Jiuhuashan ashram is in Qingyang county, Anhui province. Every year in July, there are many people who come to make a pilgrimage to Jiuhua Mountain, and transportation is convenient (Depart from Shanghai, take a boat to Datong district, Anhui province, then take a boat to Qianjia Palace, then sit on a chair with several people carrying it to Jiuhua Mountain).

Question: Why do we often call Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva when reciting the holy name?

Answer: The two words Great Vow have a very good origin, it is said in the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Bodhisattva in her previous life was once the daughter of a Brahmin, once the son of a wealthy man, once a Holy Maiden of Light, and once a King. When she was still a Brahmin daughter, she stood in front of the Tathagata's Tower of Enlightenment, Concentration of Self-Freedom, and made a great vow: "I vow to save all sinful sentient beings in the future, to open all means, so that they can be liberated." When he was the son of a rich man, he made a great vow in front of the Lion Phan Tan Tathagata, making a great vow: "I will until the future, regardless of my fate, for the sins and sufferings of the six paths of sentient beings, expand the means, to liberate them all, then I myself will become a Buddha." When she was the Holy Maiden of the Light Eye, she made a great vow: "I swear from now on, in front of the statue of the Pure Lotus Mu Tathagata, from now on for hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas, in all worlds. All hells and the three evil paths, all the sins and sufferings of sentient beings, I vow to save them, so that they can leave hell, evil beasts, animals, hungry ghosts, etc., just like people with crimes become Buddhas and then I can attain Perfect Enlightenment."When he was the King, he made a great vow: "If I do not save all the sins and sufferings of sentient beings so that they can be happy and reach Bodhi, I will still not become a Buddha." Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, without knowing that he has gone through countless eons and saved countless sentient beings, is still still a Bodhisattva and has not yet become a Buddha. The Bodhisattva's vow alone cannot become a Buddha. Just think, how great is the Bodhisattva's vow! How can I say it all? Among the Great Bodhisattvas, Manjushri Bodhisattva manifests Great Wisdom, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva manifests Great Virtue, Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) manifests Great Compassion, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva manifests Great Vows. In the Dharma Assembly of Śākyamuni Buddha, he vows to subdue and strengthen sentient beings, and vows to escape the suffering and evil of sentient beings. It must be recognized as the Great Vow of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

Question: I heard that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva only saves sentient beings in hell, is that true?

Answer: In the Vow Sutra, Buddha said: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Jambudvipa have great karma. If we talk about all the Knowledge and Benefits of sentient beings, hundreds of thousands of eons cannot be counted." In the Contemplation Sutra, the Buddha clearly stated: "From the time he first aroused his mind until now, through immeasurable and boundless experiences of countless A Sangha kalpas, he has saved Tat Ba Nhuoc Hai for a long time. His merit is complete, relying on the power of his own vow, his image appears in the ten directions. Although he has traveled to many lands, he has always created meritorious deeds. Staying in the five defilements and evil worlds, he has created deep benefits in his personal association, his body is dignified, his virtue is outstanding, he is only Except Tathagata, there is no one who can compare with all the karma in the world. Except for Bien Cat and Avalokiteśvara, all great Bodhisattvas cannot compare. The Bodhisattva's original vow is enough to achieve all sentient beings' wishes. Being able to destroy all the serious sins of sentient beings, except all karma, will be at peace." Worldly people think that Bodhisattvas only save sentient beings in hell, without thinking about the human world, which is a huge misunderstanding. In the scriptures, it is said: "Bodhisattvas fear causes, sentient beings fear results."Saving fruit is of course necessary, saving people is even more urgent. In the human world, sentient beings commit ten evil karmas as the cause, and in their next life they will go to hell, which is the result. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva still saves those in hell, let alone those who have not yet gone to hell.

Question: I have also heard that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merits and benefits surpass those of Great Bodhisattvas, is that true?

Answer: Most of the Great Bodhisattvas are reincarnations of ancient Buddhas, no one is better than anyone else, but sentient beings from many lifetimes up to now often associate dharma with deep and shallow conditions, so avoid them to avoid them. But Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has great causes and conditions for this world, so the World-Honored One praises him as supreme, and sentient beings who have strong faith will benefit. In the Ten Rings Sutra, the Buddha said: "Suppose there is someone who believes that Maitreya Bodhisattva Miraculous Auspicious and Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is the leader of Khacāsha Mahabodhisattva and Maha Yan who in hundreds of eons wholeheartedly take refuge, recite the name, recite, recite, worship, worship all the wishes. It is not as good as having one person at a meal, who wholeheartedly takes refuge, names the name, recites, worships, worships Ksitigarbha. Bodhisattva, your prayers will soon be granted. The Great Being has long been familiar with sentient beings and has great faith in great compassion, surpassing the great Bodhisattvas. Therefore, you should make offerings." In the Original Vows Sutra, it is also said: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Jambudvipa has great causes and conditions like Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Guan Yin, and Maitreya, and also transforms many bodies to save the six paths.But that's not all, Ksitigarbha teaches and transforms all sentient beings in the six paths, giving out vows for kalpas as many as tens of thousands of billions of thousands of countless lives.
